samas.samasTitleEnglish: Atmanatma Vivek (The Discernment of Atma and Non-Atma)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: आत्मानात्मविवेक करावा । करुन बरा विवरावा । विवरोन सदृढ धरावा । जीवामद्हें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साधकाने आत्मानात्मविवेक करावा. त्या विवेकानें चांगलें विवरण करावें. असें विवरण केल्यावर मग तो विवेल अंतःकरणांत दृढपणें स्थिर ठेवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be vivek between the atma and non-atma and then there should be the wise examination of that atma. Therefore within the jiva there should be this constant examination.

owis.original: आत्मा कोण अनात्मा कोण । त्याचें करावें विवरण । तेंचि आतां निरुपण । सावध ऐका ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा कोणता व अनात्मा कोणता याचें सूक्ष्म विवरण करावें. तेंच विवरण आतां लक्ष देऊन ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: What is the atma and what is the non-atma? Then, when that atma is found it should be carefully examined. Now, listen very alertly to this discourse.

owis.original: च्यारि खाणी च्यारि वाणी । चौर्‍यासि लक्ष जीवप्राणी । संख्या बोलली पुराणीं । वर्तती आतां ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें जें जीवप्राणी आढळतात त्यांच्या चार खाणी व चार वाणी मिळून चौर्‍यांशी लक्ष योनी आहेत. असें पुराणांतरीं वर्णन आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the four sources of birth, the four levels of speech then, there is this gross attention of the *eighty-four principles of the jiva. And all this counting takes place within this ever present `speech' of that ancient One (but this ever present `speech' is beyond all this counting and concepts. And that most ancient Self has nothing to do with all this).

owis.original: नाना प्रकारीचीं शरीरें । सृष्टींत दिसती अपारें । तयामधें निर्धारें । आत्मा कवणु ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या चौर्‍यांशीं लक्ष योनींमध्यें अनेक प्रकारची शरीरें दिसतात. त्यांच्या अंतर्यामीं आत्मा कोणता तें निश्र्चयात्मक रीतीनें शोधून काढावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `all' body becomes these `many' bodies then, that limitless and eternal Self sees through these eyes of flesh. How then can there be the conviction of that atma?

owis.original: दृष्टीमधें पाहातो । श्रवणामध्यें ऐकतो । रसनेमध्यें स्वाद घेतो । प्रत्यक्ष आतां ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहांत राहणारा आत्मा डोळ्यांतून पाहातो. कानांतून ऐकतो. जिभेंतून स्वाद घेतो. असें प्रत्यक्ष दिसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: But in the eyes, it is that atma that sees; in the ears, it is that atma that hears; in the tongue, it is that atma that accepts the taste. For in truth, these sensory perceptions are this sagun `experience'.

owis.original: घ्राणामधें वास घेतो । सर्वांगीं तो स्पर्शतो । वाचेमधें बोलवितो । जाणोनि शब्द ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो नाकांतून वास घेतो. सर्वांगानें स्पर्श करतो. शब्द ओळखून वाणींतून बोलवितो.
owis.englishMeaning: In the nose, it is that atma that accepts the smell and it is that atma hiding within this `all' body, that feels the touch. In the four speeches, there is that atma `speaking' and it knows only this `word'.

owis.original: सावधान आणि चंचळ । चहुंकडे चळवळ । येकलाचि चालवी सकळ । इंद्रियेंद्वारा ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा मोठा सावध असून चंचळ आहे. गतिमान आहे. इंद्रियांच्या द्वारां तो एकटा सर्व बाजूस सगळी हालचाल घडवून आणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He is alert, moving and very active in every direction. That One alone activates this `all' and these organs of sense and action are His representatives.

owis.original: पाये चालवी हात हालवी । भृकुटी पालवी डोळा घालवी । संकेतखुणा बोलवी । तोचि आत्मा ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तों पायानें चालवतो, हात हलवतो, भुवया खालीवर करतो, डोळे झांकतो, तोच आत्मा संकेत, खुणा करुन मनांतील हेतु स्पष्ट करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One moves the feet and moves the hands. That One knits the brow and winks the eye. That One `speaks' this `speech' and in this way He provides a pointer of His true nirgun Self (ie. He is not this `speech' but is very close by, knowing this `speech').

owis.original: धिटाई लाजवी खाजवी । खोंकवी वोकवी थुंकवी । अन्न जेऊन उदक सेवी । तोचि आत्मा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्माच धीटपणा देतो. तोच लाजवतो, खाजवतो, तसेच तोच खोकायला, ओकायला व थुंकायला लावतो. जेवण झाल्यावर आत्माच पाणी पिण्यास लावतो.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that atma that becomes bold and ashamed and it is the atma who is made to scratch, cough, vomit and spit. It is that atma only who enjoys the food and drinks the water.

owis.original: मळमूत्रत्याग करी । शरीरमात्र सावरी । प्रवृत्ति निवृत्ति विवरी । तोचि आत्मा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तोच आत्मा मलमूत्राचा त्याग करवतो. सर्व शरीराचा समतोल सावरुन धरतो. तोच प्रवृत्ति व निवृत्ति यांचे विवरण करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma makes the gross body to pass urine and stools and He maintains this whole `all' body also. It is His thoughtlessness that makes these worldly thoughts into the thoughtless.

owis.original: ऐके देखे हुंगे चाखे । नाना प्रकारें वोळखे। संतोष पावे आणी धाके । तोचि आत्मा ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तोच आत्मा ऐकत , पाहतो, हुंगतो, चाखतो, अनेक रीतीनें ओळखतो, आनंदी होतो आणि घाबरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma listens, watches, smells and tastes; and it is that atma who recognises the ways of the `many'. It is that atma that becomes content and afraid.

owis.original: आनंद विनोद उदेग चिंता । काया छ्याया माया ममता । जीवित्वें पावे नाना वेथा । तोचि आत्मा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आनंद, विनोद, उद्वेग, चिंता वगैरे अनुभव तो आत्माच देतो. आत्म्याची छाया असणार्‍या देहाबद्दल खरेपणाचा भ्रम व ममता  तोच निर्माण करतो. जीवदशेमध्यें भोगावें लागणारें अनेक क्लेश तो आत्माच भोगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma has bliss, it plays and has fun; it gets worried and anxious, but this gross body has covered over that atma with affections and attachment. Then due to its jiva-ness, that atma has to endure `many' suffering.

owis.original: पदार्थाची आस्था धरी । जनीं वाईट बरें करी । आपल्यां राखे पराव्यां मारी । तोचि आत्मा ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक पदार्थांची आसक्ति धरणारा, लोकांत बरीवाईट कर्में करणारा, आपल्या माणसास सांभाळणारा, आणि परक्यास मारणारा तो आत्माच होय.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is the fondness for this original `object' (ie. when everything is forgotten then, what remains is this `object' before you and the experience, `I am everything') and in the people that becomes the *best by understanding and the worst by misun- derstanding. That knows how to protect its own (ie. this `all') and it can beat and kill this `other/all' also. *(Thoughtless)

owis.original: युध्ये होतां दोहिंकडे । नाना शरीरीं वावडे । परस्परें पाडी पडे । तोचि आत्मा ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेव्हां एखादें युद्ध पेटतें तेव्हां दोन्ही बाजूंच्या अनेक शरीरांत तो आत्माच वावरतो.. एकमेकांशीं लढणार्‍या माणसांपैकी त्याच्यामुळें एक पाडतो व दुसरा त्याच्यामुळेंच पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a war, He is on both sides (ie. this side and the side beyond all this) and in the `many' bodies He wanders and kills and gets killed. That is the atma only.

owis.original: तो येतो जातो देहीं वर्ततो । हासतो रडतो प्रस्तावतो । समर्थ करंटा होतो । व्यापासारिखा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो देहांत येतो, देहांतून जातो व देहांत राहतो. तो हांसतो, रडतो व पश्र्चाताप पावतो. ज्याच्या त्याच्या व्यापाप्रमाणें तो आत्माच भग्यवान किंवा भाग्यहीन बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma comes and goes and exists within the body. That atma laughs, cries and repents. According to Its pervasiveness, that can be the Master or a lowly beggar also.

owis.original: होतो लंडी होतो बळकट । होतो विद्यावंत होतो धट । न्यायेवंत होतो उत्धट । तोचि आत्मा॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आत्माच बलहीन, भ्याड किंवा बलवान होतो. विद्यासंपन्न किंवा धटिंगण बनतो. न्यायप्रिय किंवा उद्धट होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma becomes very strong and powerful. That atma becomes wise and bold. That atma is the possessor of wise judgement (`I am the atma') and arrogance ("I am a body").

owis.original: धीर उदार आणि कृपण । वेडा आणि विचक्षण । उछक आणि सहिष्ण । तोचि आत्मा॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आत्माच धीर, उदार आणि कंजूष होतो. वेडा वा शाहाणा होतो. उश्रृंखल आणि सहनशील होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is patience, generosity and miserliness; it is mad for the objects of the world and intelligent; that atma is uncontrolled and patiently forbearing also.

owis.original: विद्या कुविद्या दोहिकडे । आनंदरुप वावडे । जेथें तेथें सर्वांकडे । तोचि आत्मा॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विद्या आणि अविद्या दोन्हींमध्यें तो आत्माच असतो. आनंदरुपानें तो आत्माच जिकडेतिकडे सर्वांच्या ठिकाणीं वावरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is the understanding and misunderstanding that comes to pra- kruti/purush. And as His bliss-form, He wanders everywhere with this `all' body.

owis.original: निजे उठे बैसे चाले । धावे धावडी तोले । सोइरे धायेरे केले । तोचि आत्मा॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आत्माच निजतो, उठतो, बसतो, चालतो, पळतो, पिटाळतो, डोलतो, तोलतो, आणि सोयरेधायरे जोडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He sleeps, gets up, sits motionless, moves, chases and is chased. He nods from side to side and back and forth. It is that atma only who establishes the relationships of brother, sister etc.

owis.original: पोथी वाची अर्थ सांगे । ताळ धरी गाऊं लागे । वाद वेवाद वाउगे । तोचि आत्मा॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आत्माच पोथी वाचतो व अर्थ सांगतो. ताल धरतो व गाणें गातो. आणि उगाच वादविवाद करत बसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He reads religious books and knows the inner meaning also. He holds the cymbals and starts to sing. And it is that atma only who indulges in worthless arguments.

owis.original: आत्मा नस्तां देहांतरीं । मग तें प्रेत सचराचरीं । देहसंगें आत्मा करी । सर्व कांहीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहांत जर आत्मा नसेल तर तें प्रेतच होते. या विश्र्वांत देहाच्यायोगें आत्मा सगळें कांहीं करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If the atma is not within the body then, it is that atma who becomes the corpse that is seen within this `all' (when you see a corpse before you then, truly it is that atma seeing a part of Itself. And when this knowledge/`all' is understood then, the body is lifeless like a corpse and this knowledge/`all' is alive everywhere). And it is due to the company of this body that, that atma can become the `doer' of this `all thing' (ie. due to this body you can understand, who am I? I am that witnessing purush within this whole created world of prakruti. And it is this moving atma that does everything).

owis.original: येकेंविण येक काये । कामा नये वायां जाये । म्हणोनि हा उपाये । देहयोगें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह आणि आत्मा यांपैकी एक असेल व त्याच्याबरोबर दुसरे नसेल तर दोन्ही कामास येत नाहींत. फुकट जातात. म्हणून आत्म्याचा देहाशी संयोग होणें हाच दोन्ही उपयोगी पडण्याचा मार्ग आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: What is this jiva without that atma? It can do nothing and is quite worthless. Therefore due to the atma's union with this body, there should be the remedy of this `speech' and then thoughtlessness should be understood (the only value this body has is to know this thought `I am' and then with this body of the `all', realize that thoughtless atma).

owis.original: देह अनित्य आत्मा नित्य । हाचि विवेक नित्यानित्य । अवघें सूक्ष्माचें कृत्य । जाणती ज्ञानी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह नाशवंत आहे. तर आत्मा शाश्वत आहे. हें विचारानें पटणें याचे नांव नित्यानित्यविवेक होय. जगांतील सार्‍या घटना सूक्ष्म आत्म्याच्या सत्तेनेच चालतात. हीं गोष्ट ज्ञानी माणसें ओळखतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The body is destructible and that atma is indestructible. This is the vivek of the indestructible and destructible. Through this vivek, everything becomes this action of brahman and He is the Knower and gnyani.

owis.original: पिंडी देहधर्ता जीव । ब्रह्मांडीं देहधर्ता शिव । ईश्र्वरतनुचतुष्टये सर्व । ईश्र्वर धर्ता ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडाच्या दृष्टीनें देह धारण करणारा आत्मा तो जीव, तर ब्रह्मांडाच्या दृष्टीनें विश्व धारण करणारा आत्मा तो शिव होय. विराट, हिरण्यगर्भ, अव्याकृत आणि मूळप्रकृति या आपल्या चार देहांनीं ईश्र्वर सर्व विश्र्वाला धारण करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The holder within this individual body/pinda is a jiva and the holder within the universal body/brahmanda is shiva. Then the four bodies of *ishwara are this `all' and ishwara is its holder (then the pinda with its four bodies does not remain, the the first two bodies of brahmanda do not remain and this is the `all' of knowledge). *(shiva/purush)

owis.original: त्रिगुणापर्ता जो ईश्र्वर । अर्धनारीनटेश्र्वर । सकळ सृष्टीचा विस्तार । तेथून जाला ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तीन गुणांच्या पलीकडे असणारा जो ईश्र्वर किंवा अर्धनारीनटेश्र्वर, त्याच्यापासून संपूर्ण विश्र्वाचा विस्तार झालेला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: ishwara is that Witness beyond the three gunas; He is the Lord who is half-female and half-male. From that brahman `there', there has come this `all' of ishwara and then this expansion of the gross world.

owis.original: बरवें विचारुन पाहीं । स्त्री पुरुष तेथें नाहीं । चंचळरुप येतें कांहीं । प्रत्ययासी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अर्धनारीनटेश्र्वर असें म्हणत असतां तेथें स्त्री व पुरुष असा भेद नसतो. हें नीट विचारानें समजून घ्यावें. त्या ठिकाणीं थोडे चंचळपण अनुभवास येते इतकेंच.
owis.englishMeaning: By clearly understanding thoughtlessness, there is neither a man nor a woman `there' and this moving `thing' (ie. sagun) `here' will become that nirgun understanding.

owis.original: मुळींहून सेवटवरी । ब्रह्मादि पिल्पीका देहधारी । नित्यानित्य विवेक चतुरीं । जाणिजे ऐसा ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी मूळापासून ते शेवटपर्यंत किंवा ब्रह्मदेवापासून ते मुंगीपर्यंत सगळे देहधारी आहेत. साकार आहेत. त्याला अनुसरुन शहाण्या माणसांनीं नित्य काय व अनित्य काय याचा विवेक करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: From the root to the end there is One. He is brahma etc. and He is the holder of the body of the *ant. Therefore this vivek of the indestructible and destructible should be known by the wise. *(Every living creature is created by these three gunas; every creature knows, has ignorance and thinks according to its capacity)

owis.original: जड तितुकें अनित्य । आणि सूक्ष्म तितुकें नित्य । याहिमध्यें नित्यानित्य । पुढें निरोपिलें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें जड तें तें अनित्य समजावें. जें जें सूक्ष्म आहे तें तें नित्य समजावें. यामधें अधिक खोलांत शिरुन आणिक नित्यानित्य विवेक कसा करावा तें पुढें सांगितलें आहें.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever is inert is destructible and whatever is brahman is indestructible. There- fore within this `speech', further discrimination between indestructible and destructible is required and this is the discourse ahead (ie. there is nothing but brahman. But to understand this, vivek is required. First to establish this moving `all' with this hidden atma and then that still paramatma).

owis.original: स्थूळ सूक्ष्म वोलांडिलें । कारण माहाकारण सांडिलें । विराट हिरण्यगर्भ खंडिलें । विवेकानें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या खोल विवेकांत स्थूल सूक्ष्म मागें टाकायचे, कारण माहाकारण देह मागें टाकायचे , विराट व हिरण्यगर्भसुद्धा ओलांडायचे.
owis.englishMeaning: By this vivek, the gross and subtle bodies (of the pinda) are passed over and the causal and supra-causal are left aside. By this vivek, the gross and subtle universal bodies are also eliminated (ie. virat, hiranyagarbha of brahmanda).

owis.original: अव्याकृत मूळप्रकृती । तेथें जाऊन बैसली वृत्ती । तें वृत्ति व्हावया निवृत्ति । निरुपण ऐका ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें वृत्ति सूक्ष्म व विशाल होत अव्याकृत व मूळप्रकृतीशी जाऊन बसतें. त्या वृत्तिचीही निवृत्ति व्हायला पाहिजे. त्याचा उपाय ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Then what remains is the universal causal/avyakrut and universal supra- causal/mula-prakruti (ie. `I am He'). `There', this knowing vritti has come and sat itself down. This vritti should become that nivritti/thoughtless. Therefore listen to this discourse ahead.

owis.original: आत्मानात्मविवेक बोलिला । चंचळात्मा प्रत्यया आला । पुढिले समासीं निरोपिला । सारासार विचार ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या समासांत जो आत्मानात्मविवेक सांगितला त्याच्या योगानें चंचळ अंतरात्मा अनुभवास येतो. त्याच्या पलीकडे जाण्यास पुढील समासांत सारासार विचार सांगितला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `speech' is the vivek of atma and non-atma, and this moving atma brings that still nirgun understanding. Within the composition of words ahead there is that vivek between the thoughtless essence and the (moving) non-essence (after the vivek of atma and non-atma, two of the eight bodies of maya still remain. Therefore thoughtlessness has to be understood). . 1 siddharameshwar maharaj- Space is not the fifth element but is knowledge. Supra-causal and causal bodies are also not bodies but they are knowledge. Earth, water, fire and wind are the four elements and the two bodies are gross and subtle. The concept of space is relative to the other four elements and the concept of causal and supra-causal bodies is relative to the other two bodies. These concepts are only to make the understanding easier.

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Sarasar Nirupan (A Discourse on Essence and Non-Essence)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ऐका सारासार विचार । उभारलें जगडंबर । त्यांत कोण सार कोण असार । विवेकें वोळखा ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां सारासार विचार ऐका. विश्र्वाचा हा जो मोठा पसारा समोर आहे, त्यांतून सार कोणतें व असार कोणतें हें विवेकानें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: If you listen then, there can be the vivek between that thoughtless essence and non- essence. This whole structure of the world is imagined. Therefore within this, recognize by vivek what is the essence and what is the non-essence.

owis.original: दिसेल तें नासेल । आणि येईल तें जाईल । जें असतचि असेल । तेंचि सार ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें दिसतें तें नासतें, जें येतें तें जातें, हें असार होय. पण जें नेहमी सदैव आहेंच आहे तें सार होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When a world is seen then, that Reality will not recognized and when this mula maya comes then, that Reality will go away. But when this mula maya (ie. non-essence) becomes That which always is and always will be, then there is that essence.

owis.original: मागां आत्मानात्माविवेक बोलिला । अनात्मा वोळखोन सांडिला। आत्मा जाणतां लागला । मुळींचा मूळतंतु ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागें आत्मानात्मविवेक सांगितला त्यांत जो अनात्मा त्याला ओळखून बाजूला काढला. आत्मा जाणून घेतां घेतां मुलांतील आरंभीचा धागा हाताला लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously there was this `speech' of atma/non-atma vivek and the non-atma was recognised and left aside. Then what remained is the atma knowing this original `I am' connection at the source (therefore He is witnessing mula maya and He is appearing as His reflection).

owis.original: मुळीं जे राहिली वृत्ति । जाली पाहिजे निवृत्ति । सारासार विचार श्रोतीं । बरा पाहावा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वृत्ति मूळमायेपाशीं जाऊन बसली पण तेथून देखील ती निवृत्त झाली पाहिजे. यासाठीं श्रोत्यांनी सारासार विचारच केला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: At this source, this knowing vritti of mula maya remains and this should become nivritti. Within the listener, there is that essence and this non-essence (ie. vritti) and therefore the wise listener should understand thoughtlessness. (First the listener knows the moving, this is the non-essence. Now the wise listener should discover that essence that is the still thoughtless Self)

owis.original: नित्यानित्य विवेक केला । आत्मा नित्यसा निवडिला । निवृत्तिरुपें हेत उरला । निराकारीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नित्यानित्यविवेक बरोबर झाल्यानें नित्य अंतरात्मा निवडून तेथें वृत्ति चिकटवली, पण तेथून निवृत्त होऊन निराकारांत जावें हा हेतु शिल्लक राहतोच.
owis.englishMeaning: The vivek of the indestructible/destructible was made and the indestructible atma was chosen. But still there is this knowing vritti (then that atma is appearing as its reflection; knowledge). It is the original desire/intent remaining within that formless nivritti.

owis.original: हेत म्हणिजे तो चंचळ । निर्गुण म्हणिजे निश्र्चळ । सारासारविचारें चंचळ । होऊन जातें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हेतु हा अशाश्वतच असतो. आणि निर्गुण स्वरुप तर शाश्वत असतें. जें येतें तें जातें तें अशाश्वत असतें, हें सारासार विचार केल्यानें समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: This original intent means that atma and this moving `all' and that nirgun means the still. Due to the thoughtlessness of essence/non-essence, this moving gets destroyed.

owis.original: चळे म्हणोनि तें चंचळ । न चळे म्हणोनि निश्र्चळ । निश्र्चळीं उडे चंचळ । निश्र्चयेसीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चळतें म्हणून त्यास चंचळ म्हणतात. चळत नाहीं म्हणून त्यास निश्र्चळ म्हणतात. निश्र्चळ स्वरुपांत चंचळतेला वाव नाहीं. हें निःसंशय समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: There is some agitation and therefore there is the moving. If there is no agitation then, there is the still. And in the still, this moving completely flies away.

owis.original: ज्ञान आणि उपासना । दोनी येकचि पाहाना । उपासनेकरितां जना । जगोद्धार ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अखेर ज्ञान व उपासना दोन्ही एकरुपच होतात. पण उपासनेमुळें जगाचा उद्धार होतों हें खरें.
owis.englishMeaning: When knowledge/gnyan and *worship/upasana remain, then that One within this prakruti/purush has not been understood. Still, on account of this worship, the mind gets lifted out of this gross world (through worship one becomes this world beyond, knowledge). *(To take the mind that was sitting with the objects and place it near God; and the one who is in the vicinity of God is this moving form)

owis.original: द्रष्टा साक्षी जाणता । ज्ञानधन चैतन्यसत्ता । ज्ञान देवचि तत्वता । बरें पाहा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: द्रष्टा, साक्षी, जाणता, ज्ञानघन, चैतन्यसत्ता ज्ञान व देव ही सगळीं एकाच अंतरात्म्याची वेगवेगळीं नांवे आहेत. हें समजून घेणें जरुर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the seer or Witness or Knower then, there is this full of knowledge and this power or creative energy or chaitanya. Then that God has in truth become this knowledge; therefore understand the best (ie. thoughtlessness).

owis.original: त्या ज्ञानाचें विज्ञान होतें । शोधून पाहा बहुत मतें । चंचळ अवघें नासतें । येणें प्रकारें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या ज्ञानाचेच मग विज्ञान होतें. निरनिराळ्या अनेक मतांचा अभ्यास केला कीं असें आढळतें जेव्हां सारें चंचळ नाहींसे होतें तेव्हां ज्ञानाचे विज्ञान होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this knowledge/gnyan is vignyan (beyond knowledge). If you search with the mind then, this `all' can be understood and when both the gross creation and this moving `all' get destroyed by thoughtlessness then, there is that essence.

owis.original: नासिवंत नासेल किं नासेना । ऐसा अनुमानचि आहे मना । तरी तो पुरुष सहसा ज्ञाना । अधिकारी नव्हे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मानात्मविवेकानें जें नाशवंत आहे असे ठरलें तें नाश पावतें किंवा नाहीं असा संदेह जोपर्यंत असतो तोपर्यंत माणूस ज्ञानाचा अधिकारी होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Has the destructible been destroyed or has it not? If such conjecture remains then, there is doubt and it means the mind still remains. Then that purush is not worthy of that nirgun understanding (as long as you continue to look for that indestructible within the destructible, you remain a separate mind. He is no-mind and you must become thoughtless).

owis.original: नित्य निश्र्चये केला । संदेह उरतचि गेला । तरी तो जाणावा वाहावला । माहा मृगजळीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनात्म नाशवंत आहे असा निश्र्चय नेहमी केला आणि तरीसुद्धा त्याबद्दल संशय राहीला, तर तो माणूस दृश्याच्या मोहांत अडकून वाहावला आहे असें समजावें.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is the conviction of that indestructible but doubt still remains then, you should know that, the atma has been sweep away in this great mirage of maya (this conviction is for that indestructible atma's reflection; and you are being deceived by maya).

owis.original: क्षयेचि नाहीं तो अक्षई । व्यापकपणें सर्वां ठाईं । तेथें हेत संदेह नाहीं । निर्विकारी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्माला कधीहीं क्षय नाहीं म्हणून तें अक्षय असतें. व्यापकपणें तें सर्वत्र भरुन राहीलेलें आहे. अशा त्या निर्विकार स्वरुपांत हेतु व संशय याला जागाच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That *purush which cannot be destroyed is the indestructible and due to His per- vasiveness there is this place of the `all' (His presence illuminates this destructible `all'). But `there' in that unmodified, this original intent and doubt are not. *(He uses knowledge but remains untouched)

owis.original: जें उदंड घनदाट । आद्य मध्य सेवट । अचळ अढळ अतुट । जैसें तैसें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निश्चळ परब्रह्म अति विशाल आहे. आणि सगळीकडे अगदी दाटपणें भरुन आहे. आरंभ, मध्य व शेवट या तिन्ही अवस्थांत तें अगदी जसेंच्या तसें अचळ, अढळ व अतूट असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this mula maya, full of knowledge, is that vast paramatma, at the beginning, middle and end. That does not change, fall down or break. It is, as It is.

owis.original: पाहाता जैसें गगन । गगनाहून तें सघन । जनचि नाहीं निरंजन । सदोविरहदित ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचा अनुभव आला म्हणजे तें आकाशासारखें वाटतें. परंतु आकाशापेक्षांही तें अधिक दाट आहे. आकाशाशिवाय एखादें ठिकाण सापडेल पण ब्रह्मविरहीत असें ठिकाण आढळणार नाहीं. ज्याच्या ठिकाणीं प्राण्यांचा संबंध नाहीं असें तें निरंतर निरंजनपणानें असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If you see it, then it is like the *sky. But that Reality is fuller than the sky. It is void of mind and is the niranjan/beyond knowledge and ever-arisen/sadodita. *(Sky/space has this quality of ignorance in it; see 13.6.19- Due to the union with the limiting concept of wind there is space and when there is no limiting concept then there can be no space and what remains is that inconceivable Self)

owis.original: चर्मचक्षु ज्ञानचक्षु । हा तों अवघाच पूर्वपक्षु । निर्गुण ठाईंचा अलक्षु । लक्षवेना ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चर्मचक्षूनें अनुभव घेणें हीं देहबुद्धीची भूमिका, तर ज्ञानचक्षूनें अनुभव घेणें ही आत्मबुद्धीची भूमिका होय. पण या दोन्ही भूमिका ब्रह्मानुभवाच्या अलीकडील आहेत. निर्गुण ब्रह्मरुप हे स्वभावतःच जाणण्याच्या पलीकडे असल्यानें त्यास जाणूं म्हटलें तरी जाणता येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When you see with these physical eyes then that thoughtless Self is all these gross objects and when you see with the eyes of knowledge then, that atma is this original hypothesis (`I am He'). In that place of nirgun, one cannot concentrate on That which cannot be concentrated on.

owis.original: संगत्यागेंविण कांहीं । परब्रह्म होणार नाहीं । संगत्याग करुन पाहीं । मौन्यगर्भा ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मीपणाचा संपूर्ण त्याग झाल्यावाचून कोणालाही ब्रह्मस्वरुप होता येत नाहीं. म्हणून साधकानें मीपणाचा निःशेष त्याग करावा. आणि मौनगर्भ म्हणजे शब्दातीत असणारें परब्रह्म अनुभवावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Without giving up the company of this `thing', that parabrahman will not be. By giving up this attachment, one understands that `essence of silence'.

owis.original: निर्शतां अवघेंचि निर्शलें । चंचळ तितुकें निघोन गेलें । निश्र्चळ परब्रह्म उरलें । तेंचि सार ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असाराचें निरसन करतां करतां सारें असार बाजूस सरलें, जेवढें अशाश्वत होतें, तें सगळें नाहीसें झालें; मगजें निश्र्चळ परब्रह्म उरलरं तेंच सार होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The inferior gross objects get destroyed and whatever is moving, that much also goes away. The still parabrahman remains. This only is the essence.

owis.original: आठवा देह मूळमाया । निर्शोन गेल्या अष्टकाया । साधु सांगती उपाया । कृपाळुपणें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडब्रह्मांडांच्या देहापैकी आठवा देह म्हणजे मूळमाया होय. तिच्यास आठही देहांचा निरास करण्याची तयारी झाल्यावर साधुपुरुष अतिकृपाळूपणें ब्रह्मज्ञानाचा उपाय सांगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The eighth body is mula maya. When it is wiped out then, the eight bodies are all gone. To this remedy of `I am' the sadhu tenderly tells, `No, you do not exist'.

owis.original: सोहं हंसा तत्वमसी । तें ब्रह्म तूं आहेसी । विचार पाहातां स्थिति ऐसी । सहजचि होतें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सः अहं म्हणजे तो मी आहे, हंसः म्हणजे अहं सः म्हणजे मी तो आहे. तत्त्वमसि म्हणजे तें ब्रह्म तूंच आहेस. साधकानें सारासार विचार केल्यास आपलें ब्रह्मस्वरुप सहज अनुभवास येते.
owis.englishMeaning: so-ham, ham-sa and tattvamasi. They mean, `You are that brahman'. When one understands thoughtlessness then, this state does not remain and there is that natural state (ie. stateless state).

owis.original: साधक असोन ब्रह्म उरलें । तेथें वृत्तिसुन्य जालें । सारासार विचारिलें । येणें प्रकारें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साधकपणानें राहून संपूर्णसंग त्याग केला कीं केवल ब्रह्म उरतें. साधकाची वृत्तिशून्य अवस्था होते. सारासार विचारानें हेंच साधायचे असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If though being brahman, the sadhak remains then, `there' the `vritti of zero' has arisen. Still on account of this zero-form, there can be that thoughtless essence when this knowing vritti is destroyed (maharaj- when you know all is zero then, you are beyond zero or not?).

owis.original: तें तापेना ना निवेना । उजळेना ना नासेना । डहुळेना ना निवळेना । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें परब्रह्म तापत नाहीं निवत नाहीं. तें चकचकीत होत नाहीं कीं काळवंडत नाहीं. तें ढवळून गढूळ होत नाहीं कीं निवळून स्वच्छ होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That parabrahman does not get hot or cold. It does not shine or become dark. It does not get spoiled nor does it become pure.

owis.original: दिसेना ना भासेना । उपजेना ना काळवंडेना । तें येना ना जाईना । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें इंद्रियांना दिसत नाहीं आणि मनाला भासत नाहीं. तें उत्पन्न होत नाहीं व नाश पावत नाहीं, तें येत नाहीं व जात नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: That parabrahman is not seen nor does it appear. It does not take birth nor does it die. That Reality neither comes nor goes.

owis.original: तें भिजेना ना वाळेना । तें विझेना ना जळेना । जयास कोणीच नेईना । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें भिजत नाहीं वा वाळत नाहीं, तें जळत नाहीं आणि विझत नाहीं, त्यास कोणीही कोठे नेऊं शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality does not get wet or dry. That Reality cannot be extinguished or set ali- ght. When that purush does not get lead away to this `all' then, it is that parabrahman.

owis.original: जें सन्मुख चि चहुंकडे । जेथें दृश्य भास उडे । धन्य साधु तो पवाडे । निर्विकारीं ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चहुकडे जिकडे बघाल तिकडे तें समोर उभें राहातें. त्याच्या ठिकाणी सार्‍या दृश्याचा भास नाहींसा होतो. अशा त्या निर्विकार ब्रह्माशी तदाकार होतो तो मोठा साधु होय.
owis.englishMeaning: mula maya is facing you, in every direction. When this visible appearance `here' takes flight then, blessed is that sadhu for He has entered within the unmodified.

owis.original: निर्विकारी कल्पनातीत । तोचि वोळखावा संत । येर अवघेचि असंत । भ्रमरुप ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वतः कल्पनातीत होऊन जो निर्विकल्प ब्रह्मामध्यें लीन होतो तोच संत म्हणून ओळखावा. बाकीचे सगळे मायेच्या कक्षेंतील असंत समजावेत. ते भ्रमरुप असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In that nirvikalpa `beyond imagination', the Saint should be recognized. The rest, due to these `many' things, are not Saints and are caught in delusion.

owis.original: खोटें सांडून खरें घ्यावें । तरीचं परीक्षवंत म्हणावें । असार सांडून सार घ्यावें । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो खोटे बाजूल सारुन खरें ग्रहण करतो, त्याला परीक्षावंत म्हणतात. म्हणून जाणत्यानें भ्रमरुप असार टाकून परब्रह्मस्वरुप सार तें घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: 2The zero vritti understands `nothing is there'. But still he is there and this is a sadhak and not a siddha 27. Leaving aside the false, one should accept the Truth; then only should one be called a true examiner. When the non-essence is throw off then, that essence can be accepted and that is parabrahman.

owis.original: जाणतां जाणतां जाणीव जाते । आपली वृत्ति तद्रूप होते । आत्मनिवेदन भक्ति ते । ऐसी आहे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सार जाणतां जाणतां अखेर आपली जाणीव नाहींशी होतें, वृत्ति ब्रह्मस्वरुपाशी तदाकार होतें. खरी आत्मनिवेदन भक्ति अशी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: By continuously knowing, that knowing goes off and your vritti becomes like that nivritti. This is the ninth devotion and it is the `surrender to the atma' and it is that Reality.

owis.original: वाच्यांशें भक्ति मुक्ति बोलावी । लक्ष्यांशें तद्रूपता विवरावी । विवरतां हेतु नुरावी । ते तद्रूपता ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्ति आणि मुक्ति यांचें शब्दांनीं वर्णन करावें. त्या शब्दांचा अर्थ ध्यानांत घेऊन तद्रूपता कशी असते तें बुद्धिनें आकलन करावें. त्यावर चिंतन करतांकरतां मी पण नाहींसें झालें की तद्रूपता साधते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this `word' meaning there is this `spoken' liberation *(`I am He'/knowledge) and due to the implied meaning, there is the thoughtlessness of pure knowledge. And due to this thoughtlessness, this original intent does not remain and there is that Reality. *(tattwasmi means, You are That. First this You must be understood. It is the `word' meaning and this `I am' remains. Then That should be understood. It is the implied meaning and it is what remains when you do not)

owis.original: सद्रूप चिद्रूप आणि तद्रूप । स्वस्वरुप म्हणिजे आपलें रुप । आपलें रुप म्हणिजे अरुप । तत्वनिर्शनाउपरी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें परब्रह्म सद्रुप आहे व चिद्रूप आहे त्याच्याशी आपलें स्वस्वरुप तद्रूप आहे, पण सर्व तत्वांचें निरसन झाल्यावर आपलें रुप अरुपच आहे असा अनुभव येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this existence-form/satrup, this knowledge-form/chidrup and that pure knowledge. That is the true swarup and it means your form. And your form means without form, when the elements are eliminated (when even the space and wind are no more). (Existence and knowledge are qualities of sagun and not pure knowledge. Your swarup is formless, free of existence and knowledge) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Ubharani Nirupan (A Discourse on the Creation/Rising Up)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ब्रह्म घन आणि पोकळ । आकाशाहून विशाळ । निर्मळ आणि निश्र्चळ । निर्विकारी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म सर्वत्र गच्च भरलेले आहे. पण तें अगदी सूक्ष्म असल्यानें पोकळ वाटते. आकाशाहून विशाल असणारे हे ब्रह्म निर्मळ, निश्र्चळ व निर्विकार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is brahman and this pervading and empty knowledge then, from this space, He has expanded (then that brahman is appearing as this `all'. Then He is space and this wind of mula maya). And when He is pure and still then, He is within the unmodified (parabrahman has never and will never lose Himself; thus He is forever free. But when there is brahman then, there is maya and she appears and conceals Him. And when all the limiting concepts and the eight bodies are given up then, He is that pure and still parabrahman. Thus when maya is forever dissolved, like the salt dropped in the ocean, then she is not and brahman is also not)

owis.original: एैसेंचि असतां कित्येक काळ । तेथें आरंभला भूगोळ । तया भूगोाळाचें मूळ । सावध ऐका ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा अवस्थेंत खूप काळ गेल्यावर त्याच्यामध्यें विश्र्नि र्निमितीला आरंभ झाला. त्या विश्र्वाचें मूळ लक्षपूर्वक ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, there is that One within the `many' and this `time' of the `all' (ie. purush/prakruti or brahman/maya) and then, `there', the earth starts to take form (ie. objectification first starts with this `all'). But how can that Reality be called the origin of this earth? Therefore listen carefully.

owis.original: परब्रह्म असतां निश्र्चळ । तेथें संकल्प उठिला चंचळ । तयास बोलिजे केवळ । आदिनारायेण ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म निश्र्चळपणें असतां त्यांत चंचळ संकल्प उठला त्याला आदिनारायण असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That parabrahman is still. But when `there', there arises a movement then, there is the desire to know and then, that pure knowledge should be called adi-narayana (the original narayana and Knower, who is accompanied by His consort lakshmi). (From brahman, maya appears and then on account of His delusion, He gets called many names. While parabrahman has nothing to do with all this)

owis.original: मूळमाया जगदेश्र्वर । त्यासीच म्हणिजे शड्गुणैश्र्वर । अष्टधा प्रकृतीचा विचार । तेथें पाहा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळमाया, जगदीश्र्वर यांनाच षड्गुणेश्र्वर म्हणतात. अष्टधा प्रकृतीचा विचार तेथेंच आरंभतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is this mula maya and her Lord/mula purush and that gets called the Lord with six qualities. Then there is this eight-fold prakruti and that thoughtless Self. Therefore understand that brahman `there'.

owis.original: ऐलिकडे गुणक्षोभिणी । तेथें जन्म घेतला त्रिगुणीं । मूळ वोंकाराची मांडणी । तेथून जाणावी ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या अलीकडे गुणक्षोभिणी असते. कारण सत्व,रज व तम हे तीन गुण तेथें जन्मतात. मूळ ओंकाराची मांडणी तेथूनच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: On this side of mula maya is guna-kshobhini (ie. in vidya maya or mula maya there is the sudden bursting out of the gunas. This begins with the sattwa guna and there is the knowing of something outside of myself. Then there is forgetting ie. tamo guna and the great elements get formed and this brings rajo guna ie. body consciousness) and then, `there' takes birth in these three gunas (ie. avidya maya "I am a body"). But the gunas origin and the place were they come together once more is this aum-form and this should be known from `there' (ie. know this knowledge; transcend this knowledge and then use it from that formless place beyond knowledge/brahman ie. maintain detachment).

owis.original: अकार उकार मकार । तिनी मिळोन वोंकार । पुढें पंचभूतांचा विस्तार । विस्तारला ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अकार, उकार व  मकार मिळून ओंकार घडतो. त्यानंतर पंचभूतांचा सारा विस्तार सर्वत्र पसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the a-form, u-form and m-form and when these three come together, there is this aum-form. But when from this aum there is the expansion of the five great elements then, these three worlds get formed (ie. a-waking, u-dream and m-deep sleep).

owis.original: आकाश म्हणिजेतें अंतरात्म्यासी । तयापासून जन्म वायोसी । वायोपासून तेजासी । जन्म जाला ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्म्याला आकाश म्हणतात. त्यापासून वायुचा जन्म होतो. व वायुपासून तेजाचा जन्म होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The space element can be called the antar-atma (ie. witnessing atma of the moving). From this the wind was born and from the wind the fire comes into being (in the wind element there is effortless knowing; both inside and outside are the same. Then there is the fire element and the knowing of a world outside of myself).

owis.original: वायोचा कातरा घसवटे । तेणें उष्णें वन्ही पेटे । सूर्यबिंब तें प्रगटे । तये ठांई ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकमेकासमोरुन येणारे वायुचे दोन प्रवाह एकमेकांशी घासतात व त्या घर्षणांतून अग्नि पेट घेतो. सूर्यबिंब तेथें प्रगट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the wind undergoes constant friction then there is the kindling of hot fire. Then that Reality is a place and this disc of the sun manifests there (ie. the wind only knows and when this knowing meets with itself then, something other than its self is felt. This manifestation is on account of the fire element and from this knowing a world outside will be revealed. This fire is the sun within each of us that reveals this world and not the sun in the sky above).

owis.original: वारा वाजतो सीतळ । तेथें निर्माण जालें जळ । तें जळ आळोन भूगोळ । निर्माण जाला ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो थंड वारा वाहातो त्यांतून पाणी उत्पन्न होते. तें पाणी थिजते. त्यापासून पृथ्वी बनते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the wind blows cool then, `there' water is created. Then that Reality is the solidifying of this water and the earth is created (when thoughts and desires arise then, forms appear within this outside world and your attention becomes more limited).

owis.original: त्या भूगोळाचे पोटीं । अनंत बीजंचिया कोटी । पृथ्वी पाण्या होता भेटी । अंकुर निघती ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीच्या पोटीं कोट्यावधि बिजें असतात. पाण्याशी त्यांचा संबंध आल्यावर त्यांतून अंकुर फुटतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the womb of this earth there lies this seed of the pure sattwa guna *(knowledge) and that endless atma. But when this seed meets with this earth and the water element then, a sprout comes out (here the gunas have manifested and then out of knowledge there appears `many' forms made of the gross elements; maharaj from the sprout house of knowledge the whole world comes). *(Where knowledge and the unmanifest gunas and elements reside; where further objectification lies dormant)

owis.original: पृथ्वी वल्ली नाना रंग । पत्रें पुष्पांचे तरंग । नाना स्वाद ते मग । फळें जालीं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांतून नाना प्रकारचे वृक्ष व वेली, नाना रंगाची पानें, फुलें आणि नाना प्रकारचे स्वाद असणारीं फळें निर्माण होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This *earth is a creeper of `many' splendours and appearances. There are the fan- ciful imaginings of leaves and flowers, with `many' tastes. And afterwards that Reality appears as the fruits.3 *(The individual objects with name and form have appeared and when there is further imagination on account of good, bad etc. and the ego of the body makes this world its reality)

owis.original: पत्रें पुष्पें फळें मुळें । नाना वर्ण नाना रसाळें । नाना धान्यें अन्नें केवळें । तेथून जालीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना रंगांची व रसांनी भरलेलीं पानें, फुलें, फळें, आणि मुळें त्याचप्रमाणें नाना प्रकारची अन्नधान्यें सारी त्या अंकुरापासूनच निर्माण होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this root of mula maya there are the leaves, flowers and fruits and then, there are `many' colours and classes and `many' experiences and emotions. Due to this food of `I am', there are the `many' grains and all this has appeared from that pure knowledge `there'.

owis.original: अन्नापासून जालें रेत । रेतापासून प्राणी निपजत । ऐसी हे रोकडी प्रचित । उत्पत्तीची ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अन्नापासून वीर्य उत्पन्न होतें आणि वीर्यापासून प्राणी निपजतो. हा तर जीचवाच्या उत्पत्तीचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: From this *`food' there has come the seminal fluid (ie. gross body objectification, "I am a man") and from the seminal fluid there comes the birth of a child in the 3 sadachar the sprout is maya, trunk is 3 gunas in balance, boughs are 3 gunas manifest, branches are elements, the sources of birth of the moving and unmoving are the leaves (ie. bodies) and the flowers are experiences, the fruits are pleasures and pains; and within these two there are the seeds of karma and the bird in the tree is the jiva. prana/breathing. In this way, that thoughtless Self and this ever-present `experience' take birth in a body. *(From that pure knowledge there comes this food `I am' on which this world depends and from this there comes the gross objectification. Then there are the `many' foods and from this blood and seminal fluid etc. are created. Then there are individual bodies and attraction and lust and babies etc.)

owis.original: अंडज जारज श्र्वेतज उद्वीज । पृथ्वी पाणी सकळांचे बीज । ऐसें हें नवल चोज । सृष्टिरचनेचें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंडज, जारज, स्वेदज आणि उद्भिज हे चारी प्रकारचे जीवप्राणी, पृथ्वी व पाणी यांच्यापासून उपजतात. या सृष्टिरचनेचें हेंच मोठें नवल आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are the births from the egg, the womb, sweat or warm vapour (ie. minute organisms like microbes, virus etc.) and the spontaneous appearance of the sprout from a seed. When there is the earth and water and this seed of the `all' then, to that thoughtless marvel there comes this *miracle that is the fanciful construction of a gross world. *(The miracle is that the One has taken `many' forms)

owis.original: च्यारि खाणी च्यारि वाणी । चौर्‍यासि लक्ष जीवयोनी । निर्माण झाले लोक तिनी । पिंडब्रह्मांड ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चार खाणी, चार वाणी, चौर्‍याांशी लक्ष जीवयोनी, तिन्ही लोक आणि सारें पिंडब्रह्मांड अशा प्रकारें निर्माण झालें.
owis.englishMeaning: Four wombs, four kinds of speech, the eighty-four lakh species of living beings, the three worlds, and the whole individual body and universe (pinda-brahmanda) - all of this came into being in this way.
owis.note: John Norwell's English translation has no paragraph for this owi — its own transliteration is present in his source text (confirming the verse exists) but the English rendering itself is missing, a silent omission on the translator's side rather than a parsing error. The English above is a direct rendering of the sourced Marathi meaning rather than an independently cross-checked translation.

owis.original: मुळीं अष्टधा प्रकृती । अवघें पाण्यापासून जन्मती । पाणी नस्तां मरती । सकळ प्राणी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुळांत अष्टधा प्रकृति आहे. तिच्यांतील पंचभूतांमध्यें पाणी असतें. त्या पाण्यापासून सारें जीव जन्मतात. पाणी मिळाले नाहीं तर सारें जीव मरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: At the root there is this eight-fold prakruti and from this water element, everything takes birth. And if this water is not (ie. gross objectification ceases) then the creature dies and in the prana there is this `all'. (Once you stop seeing the `soft' objects of this world then body consciousness ceases. When you stop seeing objects, you stop being an object and this fire element remains and there is the feeling of something non-specific within your vision. And when your breathing merges with the wind then, inside and outside do not remain and there is just the knowing of `I am')

owis.original: नव्हें अनुमानचें बोलणें । याचा बरा प्रत्यय घेणें । वेदशास्त्रें पुराणें । प्रत्ययें घ्यावीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें कांहीं नुसतें कल्पनेनें बोलणें नाहीं. पाण्यापासून सारे जीव जन्मतात याचा अनुभव घेऊन पाहावा. वेद, शास्त्र व पुराणें प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवानें स्वीकारावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this `speech' (ie. wind element), there is no guesswork and conjecture and afterwards, the best/essence of this `speech' is accepted by that nirgun. Due to the vedas, shasthras and puranas there should be the acceptance of that nirgun understanding. (The scriptures are teaching us, not this, not that/neti, neti and the great statements like, `You are That')

owis.original: जें आपल्या प्रत्यया येना । तें अनुमानिक घ्यावेन । प्रत्ययाविण सकळ जना । वेवसाये नाहीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो सिद्धान्त आपल्या अनुभवास येत नाहीं. प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवाच्या परीक्षेला उतरत नाहीं, तो अनुमानानें स्वीकारु नये. जीवनांत व व्यवहारांत निर्णय घेतांना प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवावाचून दुसरें साधन नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if that nirgun understanding has not come to you still, that Reality should not accept conjecture (ie. there should be this `all' at least. Therefore stop objectifying forms). Without that nirgun there cannot be this `all' nor the many activities of the people.

owis.original: वेवसाये प्रवृत्ती निवृत्ती । दोहिंकडे पाहिजे प्रचिती । प्रचितीवीण अनुमानें असती । ते विवेकहीन ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्यवहार प्रपंचाचा किंवा परमार्थाचा दोन्हीकडे अनुभवच पाहिजे. अनुभव न घेतां जे लोक नुसतें कल्पनेनें चालतात, तें विवेकहीन असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: These activities of this world are, in truth, that non-activity of nivritti but, to under- stand this, that purush within this `experience' is required (ie. vivek is required to turn this objectification around and to return to where it arose. Without this `experience' there is guesswork and then that Reality lacks vivek)

owis.original: ऐसा सृष्टिरचनेचा विचार । संकळित बोलिला प्रकार । आतां विस्ताराचा संहार । तोहि ऐका ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें विश्वरचना कशीं होतें हें थोडक्यांत वर्णन केलें. आतां या विश्व विस्ताराचा संहार कसा होतो तें ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that thoughtless Self and this delicate `speech' have become the ways and behaviours of the constructed gross creation. Now listen and there will also be the destruction of this expansion.

owis.original: मुळापासून सवेटवरी । अवघा आत्मारामचि करी । करी आणि विवरी । येथेयोग्य ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी प्रारंभापासून अखेरपर्यंत सगळें कांहीं आत्मारामच घडवतो. तो जसें घडवून आणतो तसाच तो सगळ्याचा उलगडा करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: From the root to the end, everything is done by atmaram only. He is the proper doer and thinker and thoughtlessness also.

owis.original: पुढें संव्हार निरोपिला । श्रोतीं पाहिजे ऐकिला । इतुक्याउपरी जाला । समास पूर्ण ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुढें संहार सांगितला आहे. तो जरुर ऐकावा. येथें हा समास संपला.
owis.englishMeaning: Ahead when there is His discourse then, there will be the dissolution of this gross creation. Therefore in the listener, there should be listening and afterwards when only this much is being made then, the composition of words will be completely finished (when there is only listening then, the words have done their work. For at best, words can only indicate and point to this `experience'). .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पृथ्वीस होईल अंत । भूतांस मांडेल कल्पांत । ऐसा समाचार साध्यंत । शास्त्रीं निरोपिला ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संहारकाळीं पृथ्वीचा अंत होईल. पंचभूतांचा कल्पांत होईल. याची सविस्तर माहिती शास्त्रांमध्यें सांगून ठेवलेली आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This earth will come to an end and the great elements will be disposed of when there comes the `end of imagining'. Within the shasthras there is such a discourse (ie. neti, neti) when one enquires and does not cease this enquiry.

owis.original: शत वरुषें अनावृष्टि । तेणें जळेल हे सृष्टि । पर्वत माती ऐसी पृष्ठी । भूमीची तरके ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शंभर वर्षें पाऊस न पडल्यानें सृष्टि जळूं लागेल. पर्वत मोठमोठ्या भेगांमध्यें नाहींसे होतील.
owis.englishMeaning: When there has been one hundred years without rain (ie. rain is desire; there must be constant and sustained understanding that this gross creation is my imagination; my real nature is knowledge or existence and to exist these imaginings are not at all required) then, due to this, the gross creation will burn and the *mountains will be reduced to dust and in this way, the hard surface of this earth will be broken. *(Mountains are established concepts and this gross earth appears by holding these concepts on account of the feeling, "I am the body")

owis.original: बारा कळीं सूर्यमंडळा । किर्णापासून निघती ज्वाळा । शत वरुषें भूगोळा । दहन होये ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्याच्या बारा कळांतील किरणांमधून ज्वाळा बाहेर पडतील. त्यामुळें शंभर वर्षें पृथ्वी जळत राहील.
owis.englishMeaning: When within prakruti/purush, this *sun of knowing shines so strong that, from her rays will come burning flames then, for one hundred years this gross earth will burn. *(I simply know, but what it is or is not, this I don't know; maharaj- when you awake, the light shines from within you)

owis.original: सिंधुरवर्ण वसुंधरा । ज्वाळा लागती फणिवरा । तो आहाळोन सरारां । विष वमी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वी जळतांना त्या जाळाचा रंग शेंदरी दिसतो. शेंदरी रंगाचा तो जाळ शेषापर्यंत जातो. त्यानें शेष भाजून भराभर वीष ओकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this earth will grow so hot that the flames will reach *shesh and while everything is burning, He will hiss and vomit poison. *(The One who upholds the earth and That which remains when everything is negated/burnt)

owis.original: त्या विषाच्या ज्वाळा निघती । तेणें पाताळें जळती । माहापावकें भस्म होती । पाताळ लोक ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या विषांतून ज्वाळा भडकतात, त्यामुळें पाताळें जळतात. अशा या प्रचंड आगीनें पाताळें भस्म होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Flames will flare up out of that poison (ie. the understanding, `Nothing is true') and due to this, the world of patala will burn (and the fructifying karmas arising from out of this causal body of ignorance will be of no consequence). Due to this great fire, the world of patala (ie. the ignorance that covers knowledge and is the cause of this objective world) will be turned to ashes. (In these fires of knowing, the gunas of raja/brahma and tama/mahesh are destroyed and only sattwa/vishnu remains)

owis.original: तेथें माहाभूतें खवळती । प्रळयेवात सुटती । प्रळयेपावक वाढती । चहुंकडे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग महाभूतें खवळतात. प्रलयाचा वारा सुटतो, प्रलयाचा अग्नि भडकतो सगळें व्यापून टाकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That One `there' will be awoken and due to the great element space (ie. witnessing), the wind of dissolution will be let loose to fan the fires of dissolution and destroy everything in every direction.

owis.original: तेथें अकरा रुद्र खवळले । बारा सूर्य कडकडिले । पावकमात्र येकवटले । प्रळयेकाळीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यावेळीं अकरा रुद्र खवळतात. बारा सूर्य कडाडतात. अशा रीतीनें प्रलयकाल आला म्हणून सर्व अग्नि एकवटून येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When `there' will be the *awakening of the eleven rudras (mahesh- I know nothing) then, the twelve suns (I know) will rage and form one complete fire at this time of dissolution (maharaj- ignorance and knowledge are two sides of the same coin). *(You are awakening from your dream)

owis.original: वायो विजांचे तडाखे । तेणें पृथ्वी अवघी तरखे । कठिणत्व अवघेंचि फांके । चहुंकडे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायु व विजा यांचे तडाखे बसतात. त्या योगानें सारी पृथ्वी तडकते, फूटूं लागते. तिचा कठिणपणा चारी बाजूला पसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: With great force this wind will blow and due to this, the earth element and those `many' things will be battered and their hardness, caused by gross perception, will be scattered in all directions.

owis.original: तेथें मेरुची कोण गणना । कोण सांभाळिल कोणा । चंद्र सूर्य तारांगणा । मूस आली ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें मेरुची किंमत उरत नाहीं. कोणी कोणास सांभाळू शकत नाहीं. चंद्र, सूर्य व तारेायांच एकच गोळा होऊन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: 4sadachar V. 1733. When that pure sky becomes this chid-ananda then, upon brahman there has appeared this cloud of maya (ie. vidya maya). This then brings the darkness of ignorance (ie. avidya maya) and the mind flashes like lightning and that thoughtless Self thunders "I am a body" (then you who are brahman imagines, "I am a jiva" and you want to know so `many' things. Then the mind flashes like lightning, revealing some object in the darkness of ignorance). In this darkness of forgetfulness and infatuation, God with His `play' makes the rains pour down. And it is only when the wind of understanding blows, that thoughtlessness disperses these rains. 9. Then the moon, the sun and star system (ie. objective world) will all be merged in this one mould of chaitanya (ie. one moving `all'). `There' who will have regard for meru mountain (`I am')? For `there' who will there be, to give regard to what?

owis.original: पृथ्वीनें विरी सांडिली । अवघी धगधगायेमान जाली । ब्रह्मांडभटी जळोन गेली । येकसरां ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग भयंकर महावृष्टी होते. त्या पाण्यांत जळून राख झालेली पृथ्वी विरुन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: This power of the earth element slipped away when, this fierce fire of knowing burnt every name and form. Then the brahmanda that had been formed from this fire was all at once burnt by this fire (due to this fire of knowing, the grosser elements had appeared and the gross creation had taken place. And just as this knowing is the base of the objective world, by returning to this base, all that is gross will be destroyed).

owis.original: जळोनि विरी सांडिली । विशेष माहावृष्टी जाली । तेणें पृथ्वी विराली । जळामधें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भाजलेला चुना जसा पाण्यांत चट्दिशी विरतो, त्याचप्रमाणें पृथ्वी प्रलयकालच्या अतिवृष्टीमध्यें चटकन विरुन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there was this burning, the earth's power could not remain and the great rains came and dissolved this earth element in the great waters (when the mind stopped naming then, the objects were burnt and what was perceived was a world without names and individual objects ie. becoming less objective).

owis.original: भाजला चुना जळीं विरे । तैसा पृथ्वीस धीर न धरे । विरी सांडूनिया त्वरें । जळीं मिळाली ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेष, कूर्म, वराह गेल्यानें पृथ्वीचा आधार नाहींसा होतो. आपला कठिणपणा सोडून ती पाण्यांत विरुन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: This earth dissolved, like baked lime dissolves in water and its ability to support everything did not remain. Having lost this power of naming it quickly disappeared within the waters.

owis.original: शेष कूर्म वार्‍हाव गेला । पृथ्वीचा आधार तुटला । सत्व सांडून जळाला । मिळोन गेली ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेष, कूर्म, वराह गेल्यानें पृथ्वीचा आधार नाहींसा होतो. आपला कठिणपणा सोडून ती पाण्यांत विरुन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: shesh, the great turtle and the great boar had left and so the support of this earth had gone. Having lost its substantiality/realness it merged in the water and was destroyed. (Having understood that the objects are our own mental creations, shesh the Knower and the incarnations of vishnu, the knowing, went to their own place and stayed and offered no further support to an imagining mind)

owis.original: तेथें प्रळयेमेघ उचलले । कठिण घोषें गर्जिनले । अखंड विजा कडकडिले । ध्वनि घोष ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग आकाशांत प्रलयकालचे प्रचंड ढग प्रगट होतात. त्याच्यां घर्षाणाचा भयंकर गडगडाट होऊन विजांचाही कडकडाचा आवाज सारखा चालू राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then `there' was the coming together of the clouds of dissolution (ie. ignorance; I know nothing) and there was the loud, continuous roaring of the thunder of maya (`I am'). Then that unbroken swarup was this thunderous roar accompanied by flashes of lightning (ie. the flashes of the mind that had once revealed the gross objects in the darkness of avidya maya now, flashed in the darkness of vidya maya ie. ignorance of the Reality, and revealed this `all' and there was the roar `I am').6

owis.original: पर्वतप्राये पडती गारा । पर्वत उडती ऐसा वारा । निबिड तया अंधकारा । उपमाचि नाहीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: डोंगराएवढ्या मोठ्या गारा पडूं लागतात. डोंगर उडतात असा प्रचंड वारा वाहुं लागतो. अगदीं घनदाट अंधार पडतो त्याला कांहीं उपमाच देता येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then even if *hailstones the size of mountains tumble down still, the wind is so powerful that it blows away these mountains (ie. any concepts that may arise are immediately cast off by this wind). But nothing could be compared to that dense darkness that conceals that Reality (ie. how to describe ignorance?). *(Hailstones are hardened water only ie. names and forms; concepts that appear as hard and as real as mountains)

owis.original: सिंधु नद्या एकवटल्या । नेणो नभींहून रिचवल्या । संधिच नाहीं धारा मिळाल्या । अखंड पाणी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशांतून एकत्र आल्याप्रमाणें समुद्र व सार्‍या नद्या एकरुप होतात. वेगळें प्रवाहच न राहील्यानें सगळीकडें पाणीच पाणी दिसते.
owis.englishMeaning: The *seas and the rivers had all come together as one water, for not-knowingness poured down from these clouds. There was no interruption in this rain and that unbro- ken swarup was mixed with this one water (that unbroken swarup `there' is always there, but covered over by the thoughts and covered over by this knowledge/ignorance). *(maharaj- `the child says, `Look father water' and the father replies, `No son that is the sea.' But the son was right. They put more ignorance in you'; This differentiating ceased and the one water was perceived; and there was a world without `many' names)

owis.original: तेथें मच्छ कूर्म सर्प पडती । पर्वतासारिखे दिसती । गर्जना होतां मिसळती । जळांत जळें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें मासे, कासवें, सर्प असे सर्व डोंगरासारखें दिसतात. पण मोठ्या घनगर्जनेबरोबर ते पाण्यांत गडप होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that brahman `there' and the great fish and the great turtle and shesh had tumbled down into body consciousness then, concepts appeared as big as mountains (the concepts that support this gross world appear to be real for their base is real; but 6 sadachar clouds are maya, lightening is mind and thunder is `I am'. It says, `Though the mind has the eyes of knowledge, they had been lost in the darkness caused by the clouds'. 715. Then even if *hailstones the size of mountains tumble down still, the wind is so powerful that it blows away these mountains (ie. any concepts that may arise are immediately cast off by this wind). But nothing could be compared to that dense darkness that conceals that Reality (ie. how to describe ignorance?). *(Hailstones are hardened water only ie. names and forms; concepts that appear as hard and as real as mountains) in truth, they are only concepts and by wise vivek they are wasted away in purifying waters of understanding). But when there is the roar of this thunder `I am' then, the waters mixed in the waters. (When one forgets Oneself then brahman, the incarnations of vishnu ie. knowledge and shesh/purush, tumble down into body consciousness and there are so `many' concepts. But when the mind drops these concepts and each `soft' water form merged with the next then, body consciousness cannot remain)

owis.original: सप्त सिंधु आवर्णीं गेले । आवर्णवेडे मोकळे जाले । जळरुप जालियां खवळले । प्रळयेपावक ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सात समुद्र सपाटून वाढतात. व त्यांचें प्रवाहपाणी आवरणोदकापर्यंत वाढते. त्यामुळें विश्र्वाला वेढणारे आवरणोदक मोकळें होतें. असें सर्व जलमय झाल्यानें प्रळयाग्नि खवळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This ring of seven seas* that had held together the earth gave up its controlling power and became unbound and open. There was only this water form when the fires of dissolution flared up. *(These seas had been the `soft' creation of objects, the beginning of separate forms. They left this power and gathered together as one purifying water form. Then the fires of knowing arose and there was only the perception of something outside of oneself, `I don't know what it is or what it is not')

owis.original: ब्रह्मांडाऐसा तप्तलोहो । शोषी जळाचा समूहो । तैसें जळास जालें पाहो । अपूर्व मोठे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विश्र्वाचा तापलेला जणुं काय लोखंडाचा गोळा सागळे पाणी शोषून टाकतो. पाण्याच्याबाबतींत असें विलक्षण घडतें.
owis.englishMeaning: The brahmanda became red hot like a furnace and this dried up this mass of water. The one who sees this end of these waters is that great atma.

owis.original: तेणें आटोन गेलें पाणी । असंभाव्य माजल वन्ही । तया वन्हीस केली झडपणी । प्रंयवातें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रलयाग्निमुळें सारें पाणी आटतें आणि मग कल्पना करतांच येणार नाहीं येवढी आग भडकते. त्या आगीला प्रलयकालचा वायु झडपतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this water dried up, the fire increased beyond anything the mind could imagine. But then, that fire was extinguished by the wind of dissolution (then there is no inside and outside of yourself; for there is you only).

owis.original: दीपस पालव घातला । तैसा प्रळयेपावक विझाला । पुढें वायो प्रबळला । असंभाव्य ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पदराच्या वार्‍यानें जसा दिवा विझावा तसा प्रलयाग्नि विझतो. मग अकल्पनीय असा वारा वाहुं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And just like a lamp being put out, the wind of dissolution extinquished this fire. And afterwards the wind was so powerful, beyond anything the mind could imagine.

owis.original: उदंड पोकळी थोडा वारा । तेणें वितळोन गेला सारा । पंचभूतांचा पसारा । आटोपला ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण आकाशाची पोकळी अनंत असून वारा थोडा असतो. त्यामुळें वारा त्या पोकळींत नाहींसा होतो. अशा प्रकारें पंचमहाभूतांचा पसारा संपतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma within the emptiness of space made this wind insignificant and due to this, the wind was completely absorbed. Then the expansion of the five elements was brought under control.

owis.original: महद्भूत मूळमाया । विस्मरणें वितुळें काया । पदार्थमात्र राहावया । ठाव नाहीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा व मूळमाया यांना स्वतःचा विसर पडतो. आणि त्यांचा आकार किंवा देह वितळून जातो. मग कोणताही निर्मित पदार्थ राहण्यास जागाच उरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is that great element space and mula maya, and He forgets her then, her body is dispersed and there is no place for even this `object' (ie. existence) to stay.

owis.original: दृश्य हलकालोळें नेलें । जड चंचळ वितुळलें । याउपरी शाश्र्वत उरलें । परब्रह्म तें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याप्रमाणें संहाराच्या धूमाकुळांत सारें दृश्य नाहींसे होते. जड व चंचळ वितळून जाते. सगळें नाहींसे झाल्यावर जें केवळ उरतें तेंच परब्रह्म होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Then the visible is demolished and cast away. When the inert and the moving abates and afterwards this `speech of the all' is gone, then that eternal remains and that is parabrahman. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Kahani Nirupan (The Discourse of the Story)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: कोणी येक दोघे जण । पृथ्वी फिरती उदासीन । काळक्रमणें लागून । कथा आरंभिली ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकदां दोन मित्र अनासक्तपणें पृथ्वीवर फिरत होते. वेळ जावा, करमणूक व्हावी म्हणून एकानें दुसर्‍याला गोष्ट सांगायला सुरवात केली.
owis.englishMeaning: The One had the body of these `two' (ie. purush/prakruti) and turned away from this earth with indifference. Due to the progression of `time' this `story' had begun.

owis.original: श्रोता पुसे वक्तयासी । काहाणी सांगा जी बरवीसी । वक्ता म्हणे श्रोतयासी । सावध ऐकें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ऐकणारा संगणार्‍यास म्हणाला कीं, तुम्हीं एखादी चांगली गोष्ट सांगा. त्यावर सांगणारा म्हणाला कीं, मी अशी गोष्ट सांगतो, पण ती तूं लक्ष देऊन ऐकली पाहिजेस.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener asked the speaker, "Tell me this good story." So the speaker says to the listener, "Just listen and be alert." (The listener and the speaker are within you only; the speaker's speech is `I am He' and the listener should hear this only)

owis.original: येकें स्त्रीपुरुषें होतीं । उभयेतांमधें बहु प्रीति । येकरुपेंचि वर्तती । भिन्न नाहीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक स्त्री-पुरुष असें जोडपें होतें. त्यांचें एकमेकांवर अतिशय प्रेम होते. ते येवढें कीं, दोघांमध्यें वेगळेंपण मुळींच नव्हतें.
owis.englishMeaning: There was a married couple, a woman and a man, and they had great love for one another. They lived so entirely as one that there was no separateness between them at all.
owis.note: John Norwell's English translation has no paragraph for this owi — its own transliteration is present in his source text (confirming the verse exists) but the English rendering itself is missing, a silent omission on the translator's side rather than a parsing error. The English above is a direct rendering of the sourced Marathi meaning rather than an independently cross-checked translation.

owis.original: ऐसा कांहीं येक काळ लोटला । तयांस येक पुत्र जाला । कार्यकर्त आणि भला । सर्वविषीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बराच काळ गेल्यानंतर त्यांना एक मुलगा झाला. त्याचें नांव विष्णु. सर्वच बाबतींत तो चांगला असून मोठा कार्यकर्ता होता.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, this `thing' and the One were passing the `time' and then one son appeared to them. He was involved in every action; he was virtuous and wise with regards to this `all' (The gunas begin to manifest. First there is the sattwa guna, vishnu and a body appears in your awareness).

owis.original: पुढें त्यासहि जाला कुमर । तो पित्याहून आतुर । कांहीं तदर्ध चतुर । व्यापकपणें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुढें विष्णुला पण मुलगा झाला. बापापेक्षां तो उतावीळ व चंचळ होता. तो अर्धा शाहाणा होता पण त्यानें व्याप फार वाढवला.
owis.englishMeaning: Later, he also had a son. He was more eager to involve himself in the world than his father was and therefore his pervasiveness was only half that of his father and therefore this `thing' was only half understood (ie. rajo guna, lord brahma. Then knowing gives way to the knowing of `many' objects). (rajo guna, you know and that is knowledge, but you don't know what it is and that is ignorance. And therefore you want to give it a name)

owis.original: तेणें व्याप उदंड केला । बहुत कन्यापुत्र व्याला । उदंड लोक संचिला । नाना प्रकारें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यानें व्याप फार केला. त्याला खूप मुलगें व मुली अशी संतती झाली. नाना प्रकारचे पुष्कळ लोक त्यानें निर्माण केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this son, that vast paramatma was constantly occupied in thoughts and then this `all' had many sons and daughters (brahma ie. buddhi creates different names and forms out of this `all'). Then that paramatma that is amassed everywhere was this world of `many' ways and forms.

owis.original: त्याचा पुत्र जेष्ठ । तो अज्ञान आणि रागिट । अथवा चुकता नीट । संव्हार करी ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचा मोठा मुलगा रुद्र. तो फार रागीट व अज्ञानी होता. कोणाचें कांहीं चुकलें कीं, संहार करणें हेच त्याचे काम होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The eldest son of brahma, the great grandson of that paramatma was ignorant and angry. And if you were to make a mistake then He was the destroyer (ie. He has become the tamo guna of mahesh; you have taken yourself to be a body and forgot this `all'. Then this ignorance gets called sleep and sleep is like a small death. They destroy you and this world).

owis.original: पिता उगाच बैसला । लेकें बहुत व्याप केला । सर्वज्ञ जाणता भला । जेष्ठ पुत्र ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळपुरुष पिता स्वस्थ बसला होता. त्याच्या मुलानें म्हणजें विष्णुनें पुष्कळ व्याप केला. पण तो सर्वज्ञ, जाणता, चांगला व सर्वांत वडिल होता.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the father remained still and silent. Due to His son, there was the constant activity of this `all'. For that eldest son was the Knower of this `all', most intelligent, virtuous and wise.

owis.original: नातु त्याचें अर्ध जाणे । पणतु तो कांहींच नेणें । चुकतां संव्हारणें । माहा क्रोधी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नातु, ब्रह्मदेव अर्धा जाणता होता. आणि पणतु रुद्र तर कांहींच जाणता नव्हता. तो भयंकर रागीट असल्यानें जरा चूक झाली कीं, संहार करण्यास तयार होता.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there was the grandson who knew only half of what the Knower knew. And there was the great grandson and he did not even know this `thing'. And whenever you made a mistake (ie. when you leave knowing), that `great angry one' destroys everything.

owis.original: लेक सकळांचें पाळण करी । नातु मेळवी वरिचावरी । पणतु चुकल्यां संव्हार करी । अकस्मात ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुलगा सगळ्यांचे पालन-पोषण करतो. नातु परस्पर मिळवून खातो, तर पणतु चुकलेल्यांचा तत्काळ संहार करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The son was the protector of this `all'. The grandson continuously added to this gathering and the great grandson suddenly destroys when a mistake has been made.

owis.original: नेमस्तपणें वंश वाढला । विस्तार उदंडचि जाला । ऐसा बहुत काळ गेला । आनंदरुप ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या या कुटुंबाचा वंश नियमितपणें वाढत गेला. आणि खूप पसारा वाढला. पसारा वाढला तरी प्रथम बराच काळ मोठ्या आनंदांत गेला.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma became limited (ie. "I am a body") and this family grew and kept expanding. Due to this, this `time of the all' that had passed by in bliss/ananda was lost.

owis.original: विस्तार वाढला गणवेना । वडिलांस कोणीच मानीना । परस्परें किंत मना । बहुत पडिला ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण विस्तार जेव्हां अमर्याद वाढला. तेव्हां मात्र काळ बदलला. वडिलांचें कोणी ऐकेना. त्यांना कोणी मान देईना. देवाला लोक विसरले. संशयानें आपापसांत कलह लागलें.
owis.englishMeaning: This expansion continued to expand until it could no longer be counted and then no one had any respect for the elder (ie. atma). And due to confrontations, doubts and the prohibited, this `all' was lost.

owis.original: उदंड घरकळ्हो लागला । तेणें कित्येक संव्हार जाला । विपट पडिलें थोरथोरांला । बेबंद जालें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार मोठ्या प्रमाणांत गृहकलह निर्माण झाला. कुटुंबसंस्था विघटीत होऊं लागली. त्यामुळें पुष्कळ लोक मारलें गेलें. मोठ्यांचें एकमेकांशी पटेना. त्यामुळें बेबंदशाही माजली.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that vast paramatma began to quarrel and due to this, that One within the `many' was destroyed. For that great head of the family had fallen into these debates, arguments and doubts of the `many' and lost Himself.

owis.original: नेणपणें भरीं भरले । मग ते अवघेच संव्हारले । जैसे यादव निमाले । उन्मत्तपणें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या वागण्याचा परिणाम फार वाईट होईल हें अज्ञानानें न कळल्यानें सारेजण भलत्या भरीस पडले व उन्मत्तपणानें यादव जसें समूल नाश पावलें तसाच यांचाही संहार झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there was an overflowing of ignorant pride and that Reality was destroyed by `many' things and `many' bodies. It was just like the *yadavas; for they also were destroyed because of their pride (ie. sleep and death/ignorance is sure to come if you take the ego of "I am a body"). *(krishna's adopted caste. He did not truly belong to this caste, for He was a King)

owis.original: बाप लेक नातु पणतु । सकळांचा जाला निपातु । कन्या पुत्र हेतु मातु । अणुमात्र नाहीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाप, मुलगा, नातु, पणतु या सगळ्यांचा निःपात झाला. त्यामुळें त्यांच्या मुलीं, त्यांचे मुलगे, त्या मुलाबाळांचे हेतु व त्यांच्या जीवनकथा , यापैकीं कांहींही शिल्लक उरलें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The father and the son, grandson and great grandson of the `all' were totally de- stroyed. Then this *virgin girl (sharada/power) and her sons (gunas), this original desire/intent and that great action do not remain in the end. *(How can the sons of a virgin be true?)

owis.original: ऐसी काहाणी जो विवरला । तो जन्मापासून सुटला । श्रोता वक्ता धन्य जाला । प्रचितीनें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही कहाणी मी सांगितली. तिचें मनन करणारा जन्ममरणाच्या चक्रांतून मुक्त होतो. श्रोता व वक्ता स्वानुभवानें धन्य होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush investigates this `story' then, He will escape birth and death. For when there is a listener and a speaker then, on account of this sagun `experience' there will be the blessing of that nirgun understanding. (The listener to this `speech' of the speaker is within every creature, but only in this human body and with vivek can this be realized)

owis.original: ऐसी काहाणी अपूर्व जे ते । उदंड वेळ होत जाते । इतुकें बोलोन गोसावी ते । निवांत जाले ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही कहाणी मोठी अपूर्व आहे. ती सारखी घडत राहातें. इतकें सांगून स्वामींनी आपलें बोलणें थांबवले.
owis.englishMeaning: Whenever there is this `story' then, there is `that which never has taken place before' (ie. realization). That vast paramatma has come and gone in `many' births but when only this `story' gets `spoken', then he becomes that Master of renunciation and remains calm and still.

owis.original: आमची काहाणी सरो । तुमचे अंतरीं भरो । ऐसें बोलणें विवरो । कोणीतरी ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आमची कहाणी सरो. ती तुमच्या अंतःकरणांत भरो. या कहाणीवर कोणीतरी मनन करो.
owis.englishMeaning: Our story is over and this story should overflow in your inner space and in this way, this empty and worthless body should be investigated by this `speech'.

owis.original: चुकत वांकत आठवलें । इतुकें संकळित बोलिलें । न्यूनपूर्ण क्ष्मा केलें । पाहिजे श्रोतीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चुकतमाकत जेवढें आठवलें तेवढें एकत्र करुन सांगितलें. त्यांत जें कमीजास्त झालें असेल त्याबद्दल श्रोत्यांनी क्षमा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever has been forgotten is to be remembered; by reducing it to this much only (ie. forgetting is remembering), there is this `speech'. Incomplete and complete, both concepts should be left aside and forgiven by the good `listener' (nothing needs to be changed, you are already That; just listen to this `speech').

owis.original: ऐसी काहाणी निरंतर । विवेकें ऐकती जे नर । दास म्हणे जग्गोधार । तेचि करिती ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी ही कहाणी जे निरंतर विवेकानें ऐकतात तेच जगाचा उद्धार करतात. असें श्रीरामदास म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This story is that *nirantar; swami ramdas says, "When the man listens with vivek to mula maya then, that Reality gets lifted out of this world." *(parabrahman ie. without an inner space; beyond time and space)

owis.original: त्या जगोद्धारचें लक्षण । केलें पाहिजे विवरण । सार निवडावें निरुपण । याास बोलिजे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगाचा उद्धार म्हणजें काय याचें विवेचन करणें जरुर आहे. सारअसारांच्या मिश्रणांतून सार निवडून बाजूस काढणें याचे नांव निरुपण होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this attention that lifts one out of this world then, there should be further investigation. That is the discourse that determines and chooses the essence from this `speech' (ie. non-essence).

owis.original: निरुपणीं प्रत्ययें विवरावें । नाना तत्वकोडें उकलावें । समजतां समजतां व्हावें । निःसंदेह ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसानें निरुपण ऐकावें. आपण जें ऐकलें तें प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव घेऊन समजून घ्यावें. विश्र्वरचनेंत आढळणार्‍या अनेक तत्वांची गुंतागुंत उकलावी. आणि कहाणी समजतां समजतां संपूर्ण संदेहरहित होऊन जावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The knots of the `many' gross elements should be disentangled and that thoughtless nirgun within this sagun discourse should be searched for. If this `speech' is continuously understood then, there will be doubtlessness (lit. no body).

owis.original: विवरोन पाहातां अष्ट देह । पुढें सहजचि निःसंदेह । अखंड निरुपणें राहे । समाधान ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंड व ब्रह्मांड मिळून असणारें हें आठ देह आहेत. त्यांचें विवरण केलें असतां माणसाला आपोआपच निःसंदेहता प्राप्त होते. साररुप ब्रह्म हातीं लागल्यानें मग अखंड समाधान मिळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is this investigation then, the eight bodies will be understood and there will be that doubtless natural swarup. And due to this discourse, that unbroken contentment remains.

owis.original: तत्वांचा गल्बला जेथें । निवांत कैंचें असेल तेथें । याकारणें गुल्लिपरतें । कोणीयेकें असावें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ठिकाणीं तत्वांची गडबड आहे त्या ठिकाणीं निवांतपणा असणें शक्य नाहीं. म्हणून ज्याला समाधान हवें त्यानें या गोंधळाच्या अलीकडेच राहणें अवश्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When `here' is the confusion and disorder of the gross elements then, how can `there' be silent? Therefore by means of this `speech', that One who is within everyone should be far away from any confusion.

owis.original: ऐसा सूक्ष्म संवाद । केलाचि करावा विशद । पुढिले समासीं लघुबोध । सावध ऐका ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असें जें सूक्ष्म विवेचन आहे तें पुनः स्पष्ट करुन समजून घ्यावें. पुढील समासांत लघुबोध सांगणार आहे. तो लक्ष देऊन ऐकावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is the subtle dialogue that should be made over and over in the mind until one becomes completely open and clear. Now if you listen alertly then, this collection of words is of little worth afterwards. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: जें बोलिजेती पंचतत्वें । त्यांची अभ्यासाया नावें । तदुपरी स्वानुभवें । रुपें जाणावीं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्यांना पंचतत्वें म्हणतात, त्यांची नांवे माहित करुन घ्यावी. त्यानंतर अनुभवानें त्यांचें स्वरुप समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: These five gross elements will get called mula maya if this `name'/`I am' is carefully studied. Then afterwards, on account of this `I am' form, one should know one's own Self through Self-experience.

owis.original: यामधें शाश्र्वत कोण । आणी अशाश्र्वत कोण । ऐसें करावें विवरण । प्रत्ययाचें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांच्यामध्यें शाश्र्वत कोणतें व अशाश्र्वत कोणतें ते प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवानें निश्र्चित करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In this `speech', who is eternal and who is non-eternal? Such is the investigation of that nirgun.

owis.original: पंचभूतांचा विचार । नांवरुप सारासार । तोचि बोलिला निर्धार । सावध ऐका ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां पंचभूतांचा विचार करु. त्यांची नांवें, त्यंचें स्वरुप, त्यांच्यात सारासार काय, हें सगळें आतां निश्र्चितपणें सांगतों. तें लक्षपूर्वक ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the non-eternal five great elements and there is thoughtlessness. There is this gross body with its name and there is the vivek between that essence and non- essence. And if that `one who requires no support' appears as this `speech' then, just listen carefully (if you who have taken yourself to be a body starts to use some vivek then, objectification would cease and this knowing of `I am' will be revealed. Then this non-essence should be let slip by the one who is truly that thoughtless eternal essence).

owis.original: पृथ्वी आप तेजो वायो आकाश । नावें बोलिलीं सावकास । आतां रुपाचा विश्र्वास । श्रवणें धरावा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वी, आप, तेज, वायु आणि आकाश अशीं त्या पंचभूतांची नांवें आहेत. आतां त्यांचे स्वरुप सांगतो, तें ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the earth, water, fire, wind and space and due to this knowing there is this easy `speech'. Now, have faith in this `form' and hold it firmly, by just listening.

owis.original: पृथ्वी म्हणिजे ते धरणी । आप म्हणिजे तें पाणी । तेज म्हणिजे अग्नि तरणी । सतेजादिक ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वी म्हणजे जमीन, आप म्हणजे पाणी, तेज म्हणजे अग्नि, सूर्य वगैरे तेजयुक्त पदार्थ समजावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: 8The elements mix together and become gross. shri siddharameshwar maharaj had his disciples study being a particular element for a week and the next week another element. 5. When there is the earth element then, that Reality should be called the world. When there is the great water element then, that Reality should be called water. When there is the fire then, there is the fire, the sun and luminous bodies etc. (and not that Reality).

owis.original: वायो म्हणिजे तो वारा । आकाश म्हणिजे पैस सारा । आतां शाश्वत तें विचारा । आपलें मनीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायु म्हणजे वारा, आकाश म्हणजे सारी जागा, आतां आपल्या मनांत शाश्र्वतपणाचा विचार करुं.
