owis.englishMeaning: When there is the wind then, that paramatma should be called the air and the space should be called complete emptiness. Now when there is space then, that eternal thoughtless Self is in your mind as `I am'.

owis.original: येक शीत चांचपावें । म्हणिजे वर्म पडे ठावें । तैसें थोड्या अनुभवें । बहुत जाणावें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भाताचे एक शीत चाचपून बघितलें कीं, भात शिजला कां नाहीं तें समजते. त्याचप्रमाणें थोड्या अनुभवावरुन संपूर्ण विश्र्वाचा स्वभाव समजून घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Only one grain of cooked rice needs be pinched to discover if the rice is tender. In the same way, in this small moment, this `experience' of the `all' should be known (take hold of this moment before you and inquire into its nature. For within this present small moment, knowledge is present. In this knowledge, when a thought is allowed to arise then, the whole gross world appears. But when you see everywhere and everything with the eyes of `experience' ie. nothing is there, then in every successive moment, this `all' can also be found and it will grow so large that, finally you do not remain)

owis.original: पृथ्वी रचते आणि खचते । हें तो प्रत्ययास येतें । नाना रचना होत जाते । सृष्टिमधें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीचा विचार केला तर असें समजतें कीं मातीची रचना करतां येते पण ती थोड्याच वेळांत मोडतें. त्यामुळें पृथ्वीवर अशा रचना होतात व कालांतरानें मोडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the earth element that gets constructed and destroyed and there is the thoughtlessness that brings the nirgun understanding. And in this gross creation it is only the `many' constructions that come and go (in the gross creation the `many' names and forms get destroyed, but that `thoughtless' paramatma still remains).

owis.original: म्हणौन रचतें तें खचतें । आप तें हि आटोन जाते । तेज हि प्रगटोन विझतें । वारें हि राहे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून जें रचलें जातें तें मोडते हें पृथ्वीच्या बाबतींत अनुभवास येते. त्याचप्रमाणें पाणी आटून जाते. अग्नि पेटतो व विझून जातो. आणि वारा वाहतो व थांबतों.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore, the earth gets created and destroyed. The water also gets dried up. The fire also shines and is extinguished and the wind also becomes still (the great elements are ultimately that indestructible Reality).

owis.original: अवकाश नाममात्र आहे । तें हि विचारिता न राहे । एवं पंचभूतिक राहे । हें तो घडेना ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशामध्यें अवकाश नावापुरता असतो जरा विचार केल्यास तोही उरत नाहीं. यामुळें लक्षांत येतें कीं पंचभूतांपासून निर्माण झालेले कांहींहीं कायम टिकणारे नाहीं. कायम टिकेल हें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is only this `name' then, *space must be there and when there is thought- lessness then, the space and `name' do not remain. Thus, as long as the five elements remain, then that thoughtless paramatma is not accomplished. *(maharaj- when space is there then, knowledge must be there)

owis.original: ऐसा पांचा भूतांचा विस्तार । नासिवंत हा निर्धार । शाश्र्वत आत्मा निराकार । सत्य जाणावा ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याप्रमाणें पांच भूतांचा पसारा नाशवंत आहे. हें अगदी निर्विवाद आहे. आत्मा मात्र शाश्वत आहे. सत्य आहे. पण तो निराकार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: For when there is the expansion of the five great elements then, it is that thoughtless Self appearing as the destructible. But that eternal atma is formless and that Truth should be known.

owis.original: तो आत्मा कोणास कळेना । ज्ञानेंविण आकळेना । म्हणोनियां संतजना । विचारावें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आत्मा कळण्यास फार कठीण आहे. ज्ञानावांचून तो इतर कशानेंही आकलन होत नाहीं. म्हणून संतसज्जनांकडे जाऊन त्यांना आत्मा कसा ओळखावा हें विचारावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma cannot be understood by this `all'; yet without knowledge of this `all', that atma cannot be comprehended. Therefore the Saint within this world should gain that thoughtless understanding.

owis.original: विचारितां सज्जनांसी । ते म्हणती अविनासी । जन्म मृत्यु आत्मयासी । बोलोंच नये ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मस्वरुप कसें आहे? हा प्रश्र्ण संतांना विचारला तर तें उत्तर देतात कीं, आत्मा अविनाशी आहे. आत्म्याला जन्म नाहीं तसा मृत्युपण नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who is thoughtless is called the Saint and He is indestructible. Birth and death should never be said of that atma (birth and death comes to this `all' but not to the atma).

owis.original: निराकारीं भासे आकार । आणी आकारीं भासे निराकार । निराकार आणी आकार । विवेकें वोळखावा ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निराकारांत आकाराचा भास होतो. आणि आकारांत निराकाराचा भास होतो. दोन्ही एकमेकांत मिसळल्याप्रमाणें भासतात. म्हणून निराकार व आकार एकमेकांपासून विवेकानें वेगळें करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: In that formless, the form appears and in the form, that formless has appeared (ie. form is that formless taking form). That formless and form should be understood by vivek (ie. form is created by words and thoughts and it changes every moment).

owis.original: निराकार जाणावा नित्य । आकार जाणावा अनित्य । यास बोलिजे नित्यानित्य । विचारणा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें निराकार तें नित्य व शाश्वत असतें. व साकार तें अनित्य व अशाश्वत असतें. साकार निराकार हे गुणधर्म विवेकानें जाणणें यास नित्यानित्यविचार म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That formless should be known as indestructible and the form should be known as destructible (non-atma; body, mind etc). By discriminating between indestructible and destructible this `speech' gets formed (see 13.1).

owis.original: सारीं भासे असार । आणि असारीं भासे सार । सारासार विचार । शोधून पाहावा ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें जें सार आहे त्यांत असाराचा भास होतो. आणि जे असार आहे त्यामधें साराचा भास होतो. पण माणसानें सारासार विचार करुन सार असार वेगळें शोधून काढावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Now in the essence (I do not exist), the non-essence (`I am') has appeared and in the non-essence, the essence has appeared. Therefore that thoughtless essence should be searched out and understood (see 13.2).

owis.original: पंचभूतिक तें माइक । परंतु भासे अनेक । आणि आत्मा येक । व्यापून असे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वास्तविक पांच भूतांपासून निर्माण झालेले सारें मायिक आहे. म्हणजें जें जसें दिसतें तसे नसते. तें एक नव्हें अनेक दिसते. याच्या अगदी उलट आत्मा  एकच आहे व तो सर्व विश्र्व व्यापून आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever is made of the illusory five elements is that Reality but It has appears as the numerous different forms and then, that One atma is said to pervade (like the space).

owis.original: चहुं भूतांमधें गगन । तैसें गगनीं असे सघन । नेहटून पाहतां अभिन्न । गगन आणि वस्तु ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चारही भूतांच्या मधें आकाश व्यापून आहे. पण तें लगेच लक्षांत येत नाही. त्याचप्रमाणें आकाशांत आत्मस्वरुप अगदी गच्चपणें भरलेलें आहे. निश्र्चयानें सूक्ष्म विचार करुन पाहिल्यास आकाश आणि ब्रह्मवस्तु यांत भेदच नाहीअसा अनुभव येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as within the four elements there is the sky (ie. that atma is there but not di- rectly perceived), in the same way, in the sky there is that brahman (ie. direct perception of that thoughtless essence). When this is carefully investigated then, it is understood that the sky and the Self are not different.

owis.original: उपाधीयोगेंचि आकाश । उपाधी नस्तां निराभास । निराभास तें अविनाश । तैसें गगन ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाश आपल्याला भासते. इंद्रियांना गोचर होते. म्हणजे तें स्थल कालाच्या उपाधीनें आवरलेलें आहे. ही उपाधी बाजूस सारली तर ते अतींद्रियच असतें. म्हणून अतीद्रिय, निरुपाधी, निराभास व अविनाशी राहतें तें ब्रह्म होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the union with the limiting concept of wind there is space and when there is no limiting concept then, there is that inconceivable Self. In this way, the sky is that Reality inconceivable and indestructible.

owis.original: आतां असो हे विवंचना । परंतु जें पाहातां नासेना । तें गे तेंचि अनुमाना । विवेकें आणावें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां हें विवेचन पुरें. परंतु जें अनुभव घेण्यास गेलें असतां अविनाश राहते तें ब्रह्म होय. तेंच ब्रह्मस्वरुप मनन, निदिध्यासनानें आपल्या अनुभवास आणावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, let there be that thoughtless investigation. But when you know mula maya then, this `all' has not been destroyed and that Reality is continuing to hold on to conjecture. Therefore by vivek, thoughtlessness should be brought.

owis.original: परमात्मा तो निराकार । जाणिजे हा विचार सार । आणि आपण कोण हा विचार । पाहिला पाहिजे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमात्मस्वरुप निराकार आहे. हाच सर्व सारासार विचाराचा मतितार्थ आहे. त्याचप्रमाणें आपण कोण हाही विचार करायला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: You should know that, that paramatma is formless; It is thoughtlessness and that is the essence. But how can you be thoughtless (I do not exist)? This should be under- stood.

owis.original: देहास अंत येतां । वायो जातो तत्वता । हें लटिकें म्हणाल तरी आतां । स्वासोस्वास धरावा ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्यावेळीं देहाचा अंत होतो त्यावेळीं वायु देह सोडून जातो. हें जर खरें वाटत नसेल तर आतांच श्वास कोंडून धरावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The end surely comes to the body when the wind (in the form of the breath) leaves. But ff you should think that thoughtlessness has anything to do with this false body or this wind then, now you should hold your breath (even if you hold the breath still you are there; that thoughtless Reality is in the breath but He is subtler than the breath).

owis.original: स्वास कोंडतां देह पडे । देह पडतां म्हणती मडें । मड्यास कर्तुत्व न घडे । कदाकाळीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्वास कोंडून धरला, श्वासोश्र्वास थांबला कीं देह पडतो. देह पडला कीं त्यास मढें म्हणतात. मढ्याच्या अंगी कधींच कर्तेपण दृष्टीस पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When the breath stops, the body falls down and that fallen body is called a corpse. And a corpse can never perform this action that takes place in this `time of the all' (ie. in this `all' everything is taking place. This body is a dead body at the moment without this power. But if this power is not understood then, one day, its child ie. this breath or prana, will leave and everything will be gone. Therefore now when this power is there, understand its life giving nature. Otherwise while saying, "I am doing", death is sure to come).

owis.original: देहावेगळा वायो न करी । वायोवेगळा देह न करी । विचार पाहातां कांहींच न करी । येकावेगळें येक ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाच्याशिवाय वायुला कांहींच करतां येत नाहीं. वायूच्याशिवात देहाला कांहीं करतां येणार नाहीं. म्हणून विचार केला तर असें दिसतें कीं, एकमेकांशिवाय एकमेकांना कांहीं करतां येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without the body, the wind is not the doer and without the wind, the body is not the doer. And when you understand thoughtlessness then, even this `thing' and the doer are not. Therefore the body, wind and doer cannot be without each other (therefore doership it would appear is a concept created by the union with the body and this wind of the `all').

owis.original: उगें च पाहातां मनुष्य दिसे । विचार घेतां कांहींच नसे । अभेदभक्तीचें लश्रण ऐसें । वोळखावें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सहज पाहिलें तर माणूस दिसतो. विचार करुन पाहिलें तर कांहींच नाहींअसें दिसतें. यावरुन अभेद भक्तीचे लक्षण काय तें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: If your understanding is superficial then, there is a man who sees this world of names and forms and he says "I do". But when you accept thoughtlessness then, this `thing' even does not remain. Such should be recognized as *undivided devotion (ie. no-otherness).

owis.original: कर्ता आपण ऐसें म्हणावें । तरी आपलें इच्छेसारिखें व्हावें । इच्छेसारिखें न होतां मानावें । अवघेंच वाव ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मी कर्ता आहे असें म्हटलें तर सर्व गोष्टी आपल्या इच्छेप्रमाणें घडून आल्या पाहिजेत. परंतु त्या तशा घडत नसतील तर मी कर्ता आहे हें म्हणणें व्यर्थ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If one should say, "I am the doer" then, this should be said with regards to your `wish' (ie. whatever happens is my wish `I am knowledge and in knowledge everything happens'). And if this is not said with regards to your `wish' but it is said with regards to your body then, there are the empty and worthless actions of this gross creation (realize doership lies with this power of `I am').

owis.original: म्हणोन कर्ता नव्हे किं आपण । तेथें भोक्ता कैंचा कोण । हें विचारावें लक्षण । अविचारें न घडे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून मी कर्ता नाहीं हें आपोआपच अनुभवास येते. मी कर्ता नाहीं हें जसें तसेंच मी भोक्ता नाहीं हे पण खरें ठरते. परंतु सूक्ष्म विचार केल्यासच हें आकलन होईल. ज्याला असा विचार करतां येत नाहीं त्यास हें कळणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore if `there', there is no doer and you are not then, how can there be an enjoyer also? That is the sign of thoughtlessness but because of the wrong thoughts ("I did this and I did that") that thoughtlessness can never appear.

owis.original: अविचार आणि विचार । जैसा प्रकाश अंधकार । विकार आणि निर्विकार । येक नव्हे कीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याप्रमाणें प्रकाश व अंधार हें एकमेकाच्या उलट असतात. त्याचप्रमाणें सूक्ष्म विचार करणें व तसें न करणें हें एमकेमांच्या विरोधी आहेत. विकार पावणारें दृश्य पंचभूतिक विश्व आणि निर्विकार ब्रह्मवस्तु दोन्ही अगदी भिन्न आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Wrong thoughts and thoughtlessness are just like light and darkness. Just as the modification and the unmodified are not the same.

owis.original: जेथें नाहीं विवंचना । तेथें कांहींच चालेना । खरें तेंचि अनुमाना । कदा न ये ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेथें सारासाराचें सूक्ष्म मनन नाहीं, तेथें परमार्थ कांहींच नहीं. जें खरें स्वरुप आहे, त्याची कल्पना तेथें येणें शक्यच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When maya is not then, there is that nirgun investigation and in brahman, the `thing' cannot do anything. When there is that Truth then, conjecture can never come.

owis.original: प्रत्ययास बोलिजे न्याये । अप्रत्यये तो अन्याये । ज्यात्यांधास परीक्षा काये । नाना रत्नाची ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूक्ष्म वस्तूच्या अनुभवाला न्याय असें जर म्हटलें तर त्या वस्तूचा अनुभव नसणें हा अन्याय समजावा. जो जन्मांध आहे त्याला नाना प्रकारच्या रत्नांची परीक्षा करतां येणें शक्यच नसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: You should `speak' with *justice to that nirgun. For if that nirgun is not understood then, That becomes the `many' injustices. How can the `many' blind people examine these jewels?9 *(vivek)

owis.original: म्हणोन ज्ञाता धन्य धन्य । जो निर्गुणेंसी अनन्य । आत्मनिवेदनें मान्य । परम पुरुष ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून निर्गुण स्वरुपाशी अनन्य होणारा, निर्गुणाशी तद्रूप होणारा, ज्ञानी पुरुष त्रिवार धन्य होय. आत्मनिवेदन साधण्यानें तो मोठा श्रेष्ठ पुरुष म्हणून मान्यता मिळवतो.
owis.englishMeaning: 9That thoughtlessness and the original `word' and bhajan or nine devotions are the jewels within the box of the `many', 3.10.27; 7.1.33 31. Therefore such a Knower is blessed and blessed again when there is undivided devotion. By the `surrender to the atma' there is that honourable and Supreme purush. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Pratyaya Vivaran (The Nirgun Investigation of Direct Experience)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: निर्मळ निश्र्चळ निराभास । तयास दृष्टांत आकाश । आकाश म्हणिजे अवकाश । पसरला पैस ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमात्मवस्तु निर्मळ, निश्र्चळ व निराभास आहे. तिला फक्त आकाशाची उपमा देता येते. पसरलेला अवकाश म्हणजे आकाश होय.
owis.englishMeaning: It is pure, still and imperceptible/inconceivable. And space is a simile for that Reality. But space means an interval, empty and expanded.

owis.original: आधीं पैस मग पदार्थ । प्रत्यये पाहातां यथार्थ । प्रत्ययेंविण पाहाता वेर्थ । सकळ कांहीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आधी मोकळीं किंवा रिकामी जागा मग त्यांत पदार्थ उत्पन्न होऊन भरले जातात. असा आपल्याला प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव येतो. ज्याचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव घेता येत नाहीं, ते सर्व व्यर्थच होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When at the source there is this expansive space then, there must be this object of the `all'. But when there is that nirgun then, you have truly understood. For without that nirgun, you have the understanding of this empty `all thing'. (maharaj when you awake, first there is space; where there is space, knowledge must be there)

owis.original: ब्रह्म म्हणिजे तें निश्र्चळ । आत्मा म्हणिजे तो चंचळ । तयास दृष्टांत केवळ । वायो जाणावा ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म निश्र्चळ असते. अंतरात्मा चंचळ असतो. तो समजण्यासाठीं म्हणून त्यास केवळ वायुची उपमा देता येते.
owis.englishMeaning: If brahman gets called the still then, the *atma gets called the moving. And if the simile of space is used for that pure knowledge then, the atma should be known as the wind. *(antar-atma)

owis.original: घटाकाश दृष्टांत ब्रह्माचा । घटबिंब दृष्टांत आत्म्याचा । विवरतां अर्थ दोहींचा । भिन्न आहे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घटाकाश ही उपमा ब्रह्माला देतात तर घटांतील पाण्यांत पडणार्‍या प्रतिबिंबाला अंतरात्मा म्हणतात. यावर विचार केल्यावर दोन्हीचा अर्थ वेगळा आहे हे समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: And if the space in the pot is used as a simile for brahman then, the reflection in the water of the pot would be a simile for atma. If you investigate the meaning of these two similes then, you will see that brahman and this antar-atma are quite different.

owis.original: भूत म्हणिजे जितुकें जालें । जालें तितुकें निमालें । चंचळ आलें आणी गेलें । ऐसें जाणावें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें झाले किंवा निर्माण झाले ते सारे भूत होय. जें उत्पन्न होते तें नाश पावते. यावरुन जें जें येते आणि जातें तें सारें चंचळ होय असें जाणावे.
owis.englishMeaning: bhuta means, something appeared and whatever has appeared will surely get de- stroyed. One should know that the moving is like that; it comes and goes. (The antar- atma is the Witness only, but as the Witness, He takes Himself to be the witnessed `all'; therefore further investigation is required).

owis.original: अविद्या जड आत्मा चंचळ । जड कर्पूर आत्मा अनळ । दोनी जळोन तत्काळ । विझोन जाती ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अविद्या जड तर अंतरात्मा चंचळ आहे. अविद्या जणूंकांहीं कापूर तर चंचळ आत्मा जणूं अग्नि आहे. दोन्ही जळून विझून जातात. म्हणून अविद्या नाहींशी झाली किं अंतरात्मा नाहींसा होऊन निश्र्चळ ब्रह्म तेवढें उरते.
owis.englishMeaning: This maya of ignorance is inert and this atma is moving (ie. maya of knowledge). The inert is like the camphor and the atma is like the fire. Both burn and both get burnt out at the same time.

owis.original: ब्रह्म आकाश निश्र्चळ जाती । आत्मा वायो चंचळ जाती । परीक्षवंत परीक्षिती । खरें किं खोटें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्म व आकाश हे निश्र्चळ आहेत. तर अंतरात्मा व वायु हें चंचळ आहेत. हें खरें कां खोटे याची परीक्षा केवळ परीक्षवंतच करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The brahman is still like the space and the *atma is moving like the wind. The proper examiner understands the difference between the true and the false. *(see 10.10.35; the moving atma or antar-atma)

owis.original: जड अनेक आत्मा येक । ऐसा आत्मानात्माविवेक । जगा वर्तविता जगन्नायेक । तयास म्हणावें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जड किंवा स्थूल पदार्थ अनेक आहेत. तर सूक्ष्म आत्मा एकच आहे. ही धारणा होणें याला आत्मानात्मविवेक म्हणतात. त्या आत्म्यालाच जगाला चालवणारा जगन्नायक म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The inert is the numerous different forms and the atma is the moving One. Such is the vivek of atma/non-atma. He is the One who gives existence to the gross world and then He is called the Lord of the world.

owis.original: जड अनात्मा चेतवी आत्मा । सर्वीं वर्ते सर्वात्मा । अवघा मिळोन चंचळात्मा । निश्र्चळ नव्हे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जड सारें अनात्म समजावें. त्याला अंतरात्मा चेतना देतो. सर्व जडामध्यें राहून त्यास चेतना देतो म्हणून त्यास सर्वात्मा म्हणतात. पण हा सर्व मिळून चंचलात्माच होय. निश्र्चळात्मा नव्हें, निश्र्चळ ब्रह्म नव्हें.
owis.englishMeaning: The inert is non-atma and the atma makes it to move. In the `all', this atma of the `all' dwells. This gross creation can meet with this moving atma but it cannot meet with the still (ie. this moving atma is the base of the gross existence; therefore by holding to this sattwa guna that is within these three gunas that have created this world and abandoning raja and tama, this `all' or moving atma is come upon) .

owis.original: निश्र्चळ तें परब्रह्म । जेथें नाहीं दृश्यभ्रम । विमळ ब्रह्म तें निभ्रम । जैसें तैसें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या ठिकाणीं थोडाही दृश्याचा भ्रम नाहीं, तें निश्र्चळ परब्रह्म समजावें. विमल ब्रह्म अत्यंत भ्रमरहित असतें. तें अगदीं जसेंच्या तसेंच राहातें.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that still parabrahman when there is not the delusion of the visible. There is that pure brahman when the Reality is without delusion (of the `all' ie. space and wind). It is, as It is

owis.original: आधीं आत्मानात्माविवेक थोर । मग सारासारविचार । सारासाविचारें संव्हार । प्रकृतीचा ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम मोठा आत्मानात्मविचार करावा. यानंतर मग सारासार विचार करावा. सारासार विचारानें प्रकृतीचा संव्हार होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If at the source, there is the vivek of atma/non-atma (then the visible prakruti remains and is taken as true) and afterwards discrimination between that thoughtless essence and non-essence then, that is brahman. For this prakruti is destroyed by that thoughtless essence.

owis.original: विचारें प्रकृति संव्हारे । दृश्य अस्तांच वोसरे । अंतरात्मा निर्गुणी संचरे । अध्यात्मश्रवणें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सारासार विचारानें प्रकृतीचा निरास झाला म्हणजे विवेकप्रलय साधतो. मग दृश्य विश्र्व असूनही नसल्यासारखें होते. अध्यात्म श्रवणानें अंतरात्मा निर्गुण ब्रह्मस्वरुपामध्यें अंतर्धान होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When prakruti is destroyed by thoughtlessness then, though this visible is there, it is empty (ie. like a dream). This antar-atma enters within that still nirgun due to this practice of listening (ie. atma/ non-atma vivek).

owis.original: चढता अर्थ लागला । तरी अंतरात्मा चढतचि गेला । उतरल्या अर्थें उतरला । भूमंडळीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूक्ष्माकडे नेणारा ( वर चढणारा ) अर्थ आंत उदय पावला तर अंतरात्मा सूक्ष्माकडे जातो, स्वतः सूक्ष्म बनतो. सूक्ष्माकडे न जातां स्थूलाकडे ओढणारा अर्थ आंत प्रगट झाला तर अंतरात्मा स्थूलाकडे खालीं येतो, स्वतः अधिकाधिक स्थूल बनतो. मग तो जगांतील स्थूल वस्तूंना चिकटतो.
owis.englishMeaning: As the meaning becomes subtler then, the antar-atma rises higher. But if the mea- ning gets grosser then the antar-atma descends and remains within these gross things.

owis.original: अर्थासारिखा आत्मा होतो । जिकडे नेला तिकडे जातो । अनुमानें संदेहीं पडतो । कांहींयेक ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्म्याचा असा गुण आहे कीं, तो अर्थासारखें रुप घेतो. अर्थ जिकडे नेईल तिकडे तो जातो. कल्पना करीत गेले तर कोणत्या तरी संशयानें घेरला जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever meaning It is given, that atma becomes that. Wherever It is led, there It goes only. When there is conjecture then that One within the `thing', falls into body conscious doubts.

owis.original: निसंदेह अर्थ चालिला । तरी आत्मा निसंदेहचि जाला । अनुमानेअर्थें जाला । अनुमानरुपी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आंतमधील अर्थ अगदी संशयरहित असेल तर अंतरात्मा देखील अत्यंत निःसंशय बनतो. अर्थ अनिश्र्चित असेल तर अंतरात्मा पण तसाच अनिश्र्चित स्वरुपाचा बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If the meaning remains doubtless then, the atma becomes doubtless only. When the meaning is conjecture then, there appears a conjectured form.

owis.original: नवरसिक अर्थ चाले । श्रोते तद्रूपचि जाले । चाटपणें होऊन गेले । चाटचि अवघे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शृगांर, करुण, भयानक वगैरे नवरसांचे वर्णन चालूं असेल तर श्रोत्यांचा आत्मा त्या त्या रसांशी तद्रूप होतो. चावटपणा चालू असेल तर तो चावटपणाशी तद्रूप होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the meaning is full of sentiments, then the listener becomes like that only. If there is the idle prattle of this gross existence then, that atma is this idle prattle only.

owis.original: जैसा जैसा घडे संग । तैसे गुह्यराचे रंग । याकारणें उत्तम मार्ग । पाहोन धरावा ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सरड्याचा गुण असा कीं, ज्या रंगाशीं त्याची संगति होते तो रंग त्याच्यावर चढतो. माणसाच्या अंतरात्म्याचे असेंच आहे. म्हणून माणसानें उत्तम मार्ग शोधावा. व त्या मार्गानें जावें.
owis.englishMeaning: It is like a chameleon that becomes the colour of its surroundings. Therefore by means of this `speech', one should understand this `all' and then hold fast to the best path (I do not exist).

owis.original: उत्तम अन्नें बोलत गेले । तरी मन अन्नाकारचि जालें । लावण्य वनितेचें वर्णिलें । तरी मन तेथेंचि बैसे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम अन्नाविषयीं बोलणें निघालें तर मन त्या अन्नाशीं तद्रूप बनते. एखाद्या स्त्रीचें सौंदर्य वर्णन केलें तर मन त्याच्याशी तदाकार होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If that best `speaks' of this `food' (`I am') then the mind becomes like this `food' only. If `there' the beauty of the female is described then, the mind sits there.

owis.original: पदार्थवर्णन अवघें । किती म्हणोन सांगावें । परंतु अंतरीं समजावें । होये किं नव्हे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें ज्या पदार्थाचें वर्णन करावें त्या पदार्थाशीं मन एकाकार होऊन जातें. अशीं कितीतरी उदाहरणें देतां येतील. वर्ण्य वस्तूशीं मन तदाकार होतें का नाहीं हें ज्यानें त्यानें आपल्या अंतरींच्या अनुभवावरुन ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When the objects of the world are described then everything is there. Therefore the `many' thoughts should know thoughtlessness. But first in your inner space, it should be understood, what is true and what is false.

owis.original: जें जें देखिलें आणी ऐकिलें । तें अंतरीं सदृढ बैसलें । हित अन्हित परीक्षिलें । परीक्षवंतीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस डोळ्यांनीं जें जें पाहातो आणि कानांनी जें जें ऐकतो तें त्याच्या अंतर्यामी घट्टपणें जाऊन बसते. त्यापैकी आपल्या हिताचे व अनहिताचे कोणते याची परीक्षा परिक्षवंत करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya contemplates on this `all' and listens to this `all' only, then that Reality gets firmly established in your inner space. Only the true examiner examines and selects that which is most beneficial and throws away that which is not.

owis.original: याकारणें सर्व सांडावें । येक देवास धुंडावें । तरीच वर्म पडे ठावें । कांहींयेक ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून इतर सर्व कांहीं सोडून द्यावें व एका देवाचाच शोध घ्यावा. असें केलें तरच जीवनाचें रहस्य कांहीं प्रमाणांत उलगडेल.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this `speech' there is this `all' and then, that is to be left aside and the One God searched out. Then only will the essence be found, the One within this `thing'.

owis.original: नाना सुखें देवें केलीं । लोकें तयास चुकलीं । ऐसीं चुकतां च गेलीं । जन्मवरी ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवानें अनेक प्रकारची उत्तम सुखें निर्माण केली आहेत. पण अज्ञानामुळें ती लोकांना मिळत नाहीत. मार्ग चुकल्यानें जन्मभर तीं सुखें त्यांना मिळत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: God has created the `many' pleasures but due to these, that Reality has been forgotten/neglected by the world. And when there is such forgetfulness then, an entire life-time goes by wasted.

owis.original: सर्व सांडून शोधा मजला । ऐसें देवचि बोलिला । लोकीं शब्द अमान्य केला । भगवंताचा ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " इतर सारें सोडून माझा शोध करा. " असें भगवंतच बोलून गेला आहे. पण लोक भगवंताच्या शब्दाला मानीत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: God said, "Leave off this `all' and search out Me." But in this world, this `word' of God is not even respected.

owis.original: म्हणोन नाना दुःखें भोगिती । सर्वकाळ कष्टी होती । मनीं सुखचि इच्छिती । परी तें कैचें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याचा परिणाम असा होतो कीं, लोकांना नाना प्रकारची दुःखें भोगावी लागतात. त्यांना सर्व काळ कष्टांत काढावा लागतो. मनांत सुख मिळावें अशी इच्छा असतें पण तें मिळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the `many' pains are endured and then this `time of the all' becomes one exhausting vexation after another. And even if, in the mind, there is the happiness of this `wish' (`I want to simply know'), still how can this be that Reality? (No-mind is no `wish')

owis.original: उदंड सुख जया लागलें । वेडें तयास चुकलें । सुख सुख म्हणताच मेलें । दुःख भोगितां ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वास्तविक माणसापाशी फार मोठा सुखाचा वाटा आहे. पण आपल्या अज्ञानानें त्या सुखास तो मुकतो. मला सुख हवें असा त्यास ध्यास असतो. पण जन्मभर तो दुःख भोगीतच मरुन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: The happiness of that paramatma comes to mula maya but the one who is mad after the objects neglects and loses His Reality. And then while saying, "This is happiness and that is happiness", he dies enduring great suffering.

owis.original: शाहाण्यानें ऐसें न करावें । सुख होये तेंचि करावें । देवासि धुंडित जावें । ब्रह्मांडापरतें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तरी शहाण्या माणसानें असें करु नये. या जन्मांत भगवंताचें सुख आपल्याला मिळेल असें त्यानें वागावें. देवाचा शोध करण्यामध्यें ब्रह्मांड पालथे घालावें. ब्रह्मांडाच्या पलीकडे जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: By exercising wisdom, such a situation will not arise and one will become truly happy. Therefore God should be searched out beyond this brahmanda/gross creation.

owis.original: मुख्य देवचि ठाईं पडिला । मग काये उणे तयाला । लोक वेडे विवेकाला । सांडून जाती ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुख्य देव हस्तगत झाल्यानंतर मग कशाला कांहीं कमी पडत नाहीं. लोक वेडेपणा करतात.विवेकाला सोडून अविवेकानें वागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that main God is found then, what is imperfect and wanting? But the gross world of those mad after the objects, have lost their vivek.

owis.original: विवेकाचें फळ तें सुख । अविवेकाचें फळ तें दुःख । यांत मानेल तें अवश्यक । केलें पाहिजे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विवेकानें वागण्याचें फळ सुख तर अविवेकानें वागण्याचें फळ दुःख होय. यापैकीं मनाला जें पटेल तें माणसानें करावें. अगदी अवश्य करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the fruit of vivek then, there is happiness and when there is the fruit of a-vivek then, there is suffering. Therefore there should be unwavering respect for this `speech'.

owis.original: कर्तयासी वोळखावें । यास विवेक म्हणावें । विवेक सांडितां व्हावें । परम दुःखी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरा जो कर्ता आहे त्याला ओळखावें याचें नांव विवेक होय. ज्यानें हा विवेक सोडला तो अतिशय दुःखी होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The doer should be recognised. Such vivek is this `speech' of `I am'. But if this vivek is left aside, then that Supreme suffers so much.

owis.original: आतां असो हें बोलणें । कर्त्यास वोळखणें । आपलें हित विचक्षणें । चुकों नये ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां हें बोलणें पुरें झालें. खर्‍या कर्त्यास ओळखणें यामध्यें आपलें हित किंवा कल्यााण आहे. शाहाण्या माणसानें तें हित साधण्यास चुकूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, when thoughtlessness (essence/non-essence vivek) is this `speech' (atma/anatma vivek) then, prakruti remains and there is a doer. By means of this knowing, That which is most beneficial should not be forgotten and lost. (When there is a known, there must be a Knower and when there is this `action' there must be the Doer) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Karta Nirupan (A Discourse on the Doer)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: श्रोता म्हणे वक्तयासी । कोण कर्ता निश्र्चयेंसीं । सकळ सृष्टि ब्रह्मांडासी । कोणें केलें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांनीं वक्त्याला असा प्रश्र्ण केला कीं, " हीं सगळीं सृष्टि आणि ब्रह्मांड कोणी रचले? निश्र्चितपणें याचा कर्ता कोण आहे? "
owis.englishMeaning: The listener says to the speaker, "Who is truly the doer? And who has created this `all', the gross world and this whole universe/brahmanda?"

owis.original: तव बोलिले सभानायेक । जे बोलिके येकाहून येक । या बोलण्याचें कौतुक । श्रोतीं सादर ऐकावें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेव्हां सभेतून एकाहून एक हुशार असे लोक पुढें आले. आणि आपापल्या मतानें याचे उत्तर देऊं लागले. त्या उत्तराचे कौतुक श्रोत्यांनी सादर होऊन ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Even while there is a gross creation still, there is this `all' (prakruti) and also that leader (purush) of this meeting place called the `all'. His eloquent `speech' is `I am' and this is the moving within that One who is still. Therefore the wonder of this `I am' should be earnestly listened to by the good listener.

owis.original: येक म्हणती कर्ता देव । येक म्हणती कोण देव । आपुलाला अभिप्राव । बोलते जाले ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक म्हणाला कीं देव कर्ता आहे. त्यावर एकानें म्हटलें कीं हा देव कोण आहे?  प्रत्येकानें आपले आपले मत सांगितलें.
owis.englishMeaning: Otherwise someone will say, "God is the doer" and then, another will say, "Who is God?" This is all due to the appearance of this `I am' and our own importance (we say, "I am so and so and there is a God and doer" etc. because we have taken ourselves to be someone within this `I am' feeling. But when this `I am' is worshipped then, such questions and opinions will not arise).

owis.original: उत्तम मध्यम कनिष्ठ । भावार्थें बोलती पष्ट । आपुलाली उपासना श्रेष्ठ । मानिती जनीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या त्याच्या श्रद्धेप्रमाणें ज्यानें त्यानें उत्तम, मध्यम किंवा कनिष्ठ देवांना कर्तेपण बहाल केलें. प्रत्येकाला आपापला उपास्य देव श्रेष्ठ वाटणें हीं जनरीतच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: It all depends upon our faith whether the nature of our worship is of the best (I do not exist), the middle (`I am') or the inferior (idols etc.). However in this world, whatever worship the people make is considered by them as the best.

owis.original: कोणीयेक ऐसें म्हणती । कर्ता देव मंगळमूर्ती । येक म्हणती सरस्वती । सर्व करी ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी असें म्हणतात कीं मंगलमूर्ती म्हणजे गणपती हा कर्ता आहे. तर कोणी म्हणतात कीं, सरस्वती सर्व करते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that One who is within everyone (but due to its ignorance) says, "shri ganesh is the God and doer." And that One says, "saraswati does everything."

owis.original: येक म्हणती कर्ता भैरव । येक म्हणती खंडेराव । येक म्हणती वीरेदेव । येक म्हणती भगवती ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, भैरव, किंवा खंडेराव किंवा बीरदेव किंवा भगवती.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "bhairav is the doer"; another says, "khandero"; and another says, "bi- radeva"; and yet another says, "bhagavati." (The One who is beyond doership becomes a jiva and there are so `many' opinions)

owis.original: येक म्हणती नरहरी । येक म्हणती बनशंकरी । येक म्हणती सर्व करी । नारायेणु ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किंवा नरहरी किंवा बनशंकरी किंवा नारायण सर्व कांहीं करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "narahari"; another says, "banashankari"; and another says, "The doer of all is narayana."

owis.original: येक म्हणती श्रीराम कर्ता । येक म्हणती श्रीकृष्ण कर्ता । येक म्हणती भगवंत कर्ता । केशवराज ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, श्रीराम किंवा श्रीकृष्ण किंवा केशवराज भगवंत
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "shri ram is the doer"; another says, "shri krishna is the doer'; and another says, "The God who does is keshavaraj."

owis.original: येक म्हणती पांडुरंग । येक म्हणती श्रीरंग । येक म्हणती झोटिंग । सर्व करी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किंवा पांडुरंग किंचा श्रीरंग किंवा झोटिंग सर्व कांहीं करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "panduranga'; the One says, "shriranga"; the One says, "zoting (a ghost) is the doer of all this."

owis.original: येक म्हणती मुंज्या कर्ता । येक म्हणती सूर्य कर्ता । येक म्हणती अग्न कर्ता । सकळ कांहीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, मुंज्या किंवा सूर्य किंवा अग्नि
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "munjya is the doer"; the One says, "The sun is the doer"; the One says, "agni/fire is the doer of all these things."

owis.original: येक म्हणती लक्ष्मी करी । येक म्हणती मारुती करी । येक म्हणती धरत्री करी । सर्व कांहीं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किंवा लक्ष्मी किंवा मारुती किंवा पृथ्वी
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "lakshmi is the doer"; the One says, "maruti is the doer"; the One says, "The mother earth is the doer of all these things."

owis.original: येक म्हणती तुकाई । येक म्हणती येमाई । येक म्हणती सटवाई । सर्व करी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किंवा तुकाई किंवा यमाई किंवा सटवाई सर्व कांहीं करते.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "tukai"; the One says, "yamai"; the One says, "satawai is the doer of all."

owis.original: येक म्हणती भार्गव कर्ता । येक म्हणती वामन कर्ता । येक म्हणती परमात्मा कर्ता । येकचि आहे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, भार्गव किंवा वामन परमात्मा कर्ता एकच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "bhargava is the doer"; the One says, "vamana is the doer" and the One says, "paramatma is the one and only doer."

owis.original: येक म्हणती विरणा कर्ता । येक म्हणती बस्वंणा कर्ता । येक म्हणती रेवंणा कर्ता । सर्व कांहीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात वीरण्णा किंवा बसवण्णा किंवा रेवण्णा
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, `viranna is the doer"; the One says, "baswanna is the doer" and the One says, `ravanna is the doer of all these things."

owis.original: कोणी म्हणती रवळया कर्ता । येक म्हणती स्वामी कार्तिक कर्ता । येक म्हणती वेंकटेश कर्ता । सर्व कांहीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किंवा रवळनाथ किंवा कार्तिकस्वामी किंवा व्यंकटेश किंवा
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "rawalnath is the doer"; the One says, "swami kartik is the doer" and the One says, "venkatesh is the doer of all these things."

owis.original: येक म्हणती गुरु कर्ता । येक म्हणती दत्त कर्ता । येक म्हणती मुख्य कर्ता । वोढ्या जगन्नाथ ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गुरु किंवा दत्त किंवा वोढ्या जगन्नाथ मुख्य कर्ता आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "guru is the doer"; the One says, `datta is the doer" and the One says, "The main doer is vodhya jagannath."

owis.original: येक म्हणती ब्रह्मा कर्ता । येक म्हणती विष्णु कर्ता । येक म्हणती महेश कर्ता । निश्र्चयेंसीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, ब्रह्मा किंवा विष्णु किंवा महेश निश्र्चयानें कर्ता आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "brahma is the doer"; the One says, "vishnu is the doer"; and the One says, "mahesh is definitely the doer."

owis.original: येक म्हणती प्रजन्य कर्ता । येक म्हणती वायो कर्ता । येक म्हणती करुन अकर्ता । निर्गुण देव ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, पर्जन्य किंवा वायु कर्ता आहे. कोणी म्हणतात कीं, निर्गुण देव सर्व करुन अकर्ता आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "There is no God, the monsoon rains do"; the One says, "The wind does" and the One says, "The nirguna God is the non-doer, doing."

owis.original: येक म्हणती माया करी । येक म्हणती जीव करी । येक म्हणती सर्व करी । प्रारब्धयोग ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, माया किंवा जीव किंवा प्रारब्धयोग सर्व कांहीं करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "maya is the doer"; the One says, "The jiva is the doer"; and the One says, "The doer of all this is karma."

owis.original: येक म्हणती प्रेत्न करी । येक म्हणती स्वभाव करी । येक म्हणती कोण करी । कोण जाणे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात कीं, प्रयत्न किंवा स्वभाव सर्व कांहीं करतो. तर कोणी म्हणतात कीं, हे सर्व कोण करतो कोण जाणे.
owis.englishMeaning: The One says, "Effort is the doer"; the One says, "It all happens spontaneously" and the One says, "Who knows who the doer is?"

owis.original: ऐसा कर्त्याचा विचार । पुसतां भरला बाजार । आतां कोणाचें उत्तर । खरें मानावें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या सृष्टीचा कर्ता कोण? हा प्रश्र्ण विचारल्यावर असा उत्तरांचा बाजार भरला. आतां यांत कोणाचे उत्तर खरें मानायचे सांगा.
owis.englishMeaning: If you ask who the doer is, then there is this overflowing market place of opinions. Now, whose answer should be valued as true?

owis.original: जेहिं जो देव मानिला । कर्ता म्हणती तयाला । ऐसा लोकांचा गल्बला । वोसरेना ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो ज्या देवाला मानतो त्याला तो कर्ता म्हणतो, अनेक देवांना मानणार्‍या अनेक लोकांचा हा गोंधळ कांहीं कमी होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If that purush regards this mula maya as God (He, who is Himself God gets deluded and takes His prakruti as real. And on account of the delusion, more confusion comes) then, the people end up saying things like, "That Reality is the doer.' Such is the unending confusion within the world and it does not subside.

owis.original: आपुलाल्या साभिमानें । निश्र्चयेचि केला मनें । याचा विचार पाहाणें । घडेचिना ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येक माणूस स्वतःच्या देवतेचा अभिमान धरतो. आणि सर्व कर्तेपण तिथेंच आहे असा आपल्या मनानें निश्र्चय करतो. पण तें खरें कीं खोटे याचा तो विचार करीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if in our minds there is this conviction of this `all' still, this creates great pride and then this understanding of the `speech' will not accomplish thoughtlessness.

owis.original: बहु लोकांचा बहु विचार । अवघा राहों द्या बाजार । परंतु याचा विचार । ऐसा आहे ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा प्रकारें पुष्कळ लोकांची पुष्कळ मतें आहेत. निरनिराळ्या मतांचा बाजार आपण बाजूस ठेवूं. मूळ प्रश्र्णाचा खरा विचार असा आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: And when there is this world of the `many' then, thoughtlessness becomes the `many' thoughts. Therefore the `many' opinions are to be refrained from and left at the market place. But the thoughtlessness within this `speech' is such that, in a moment, it goes to that market place and accepts some opinion (though being ourselves that thoughtless Self still, we invite the `many' thoughts in; we like the `many' thoughts for they sustain our sense of being someone).

owis.original: श्रोतीं व्हावें सावधान । निश्र्चयें तोडावा अनुमान । प्रत्यये मानावा प्रमाण । जाणते पुरुषीं ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्षोत्यांनी आतां सावधान व्हावें. कर्त्याचा निश्र्चय करुन कल्पना सोडावी. जाणत्या पुरुषांनीं प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव पाहून कर्त्याचा निश्र्चय करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: In the listener, there should be alertness and conjecture is to be severed by this conviction `I am'. And then only the nirgun understanding should be accepted as the Truth, by that knowing purush.

owis.original: जें जें कर्तयानें केलें । तें तें त्याउपरी जालें । कर्त्यापूर्वीं आडळलें । न पाहिजे कीं ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कर्ता जें जें कांहीं निर्माण करतो तें तें त्याच्यानंतर निर्माण झालेले असते. कर्त्याच्या आधीं तें अस्तित्वांत नसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever has been created by a creator has appeared after the creator. This cannot occur before the creator.

owis.original: केलें तें पंचभूतिक । आणि पंचभूतिक ब्रह्मादिक । तरी भूतांशें पंचभूतिक । केलें तें घडेना ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अनुभवास येणारें हें दृश्य विश्र्व पंचभूतिक आहे. ब्रह्मादिदेव हे देखील पंचभूतिकच आहेत. म्हणून पंचभूतिक देवांनी पंचभूतिक विश्व निर्माण केलें असें होणार नाहीं. पंचभूतांच्या अंशांनी पंचभूतिक विश्र्व निर्माण करणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: And if whatever has been created is made up of the five great elements then, even lord brahma, vishnu and mahesh are elemental. And how can something else that is elemental create this elemental world? (It is said that brahma is the creator of this gross world, vishnu maintains it and mahesh destroys it. But these gunas have appeared from within this mula maya. How can they be the creator?)

owis.original: पंचभूतांस वेगळें करावें । मग कर्त्यास वोळखावें । पंचभूतिक तें स्वभावें । कर्त्यांत आले ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग कर्ता शोधून काढण्यासाठीं पंचभूतांना बाजूस वेगळें काढावें आणि नंतर कर्ता कोण तें ओळखावें. याचें कारण असें कीं, पंचभूतें स्वतः जड असल्यानें ती स्वतः कांहीं निर्माण करत नाहींत. पण जो कोणी कर्ता आहे त्याच्यामध्यें ती सहजच अंतर्भूत आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the five elements should be set aside and then the doer should be reco- gnized. Then this elemental will naturally appear within the doer (`I am everything, everywhere').

owis.original: पंचभूतांवेगळें निर्गुण । तेथें नाहीं कर्तेपण । निर्विकारास विकार कोण । लाऊं शके ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचभूतांना वेगळें केलें कीं निर्गुण उरते. तेथें कर्तेपण नसतें. कर्तेपण हा विकार आहे. निर्विकार स्वरुपाला विकार लावता येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That nirgun is separate to these five great elements but there is no doership `there'. How can this quality of changing/modification possibly be attached to that change- less/unmodified? (That which is separate from the five elements is nirgun and that nirgun cannot be a doer, for in `no-otherness', nothing is happening)

owis.original: निर्गुणास कर्तव्य न घडे । सगुण जात्यांत सापडे । आतां कर्तव्यता कोणकडे । बरें पाहा ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: येथें अडचण अशी कीं, निर्गुणाला कर्तेपण लावता येत नाहीं. सगुण हें निर्माण झालेले असल्यानें त्यास कर्तेपण देता येत नाहीं. मग अखेर कर्तेपण कोणाला द्यायचे हा प्रश्र्ण शिल्लक राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The power of doing cannot be placed with the nirgun and therefore it has to be in this created sagun that a doer is to be found. But it was already established that doership cannot be by something in the elements; so now who does doership belong to? Therefore understand the best (thoughtlessness).

owis.original: लटिक्याचा कर्ता कोण । हें पुसणेंचि अप्रमाण । म्हणोनि हेंचि प्रमाण । जें स्वभावेंचि जालें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याचें उत्तर असें कीं, ब्रह्मवस्तूकडून पाहिलें तर सारें दृश्य विश्र्व लटकें आहे. भ्रम आहे. जें मुळांत नाहींच नाहीं, त्याचा कर्ता कोण हे विचारणे गैर आहे. म्हणून हें विश्र्व स्वभावतःच झालें असें म्हणणे योग्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: How can it be correct to ask, "Who is the creator of the false?" Therefore that thoughtless Self is the only Truth and this mula maya is by nature false.

owis.original: येक सगुण येक निर्गुण । कोठें लाऊं कर्तेपण । या अर्थाचें विवरण । बरें पाहा ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक सगुण व दुसरे निर्गुण आहे. या दोन्हीपैकी कोणाकडेही सृष्टिचें कर्तेपण देतां येत नाहीं. या अर्थाचे विवेचन कसें तें पाहा.
owis.englishMeaning: When this sagun is that One nirgun then, where will doership be placed? (This ques- tion of doership, has arisen due to this false body concept) Make a careful examination of this `speech' and understand the best.

owis.original: सगुणें सगुण केलें । तरी तें पूर्वींच आहे जालें । निर्गुणास कर्तव्य लाविलें । नवचे कीं कदा ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगुणानें सगुण निर्माण केलें असें म्हणावें तर सगुण आधीच निर्माण झालेलें आहे. याचा अर्थ असा कीं, सगुणाचा कर्ता सगुणाच्या आधींच असतो. तो सगुण निर्माण करतो. तो सगुणांत अंतर्भूत होत नाहीं. जें निर्गुण आहें तें निर्विकारी असल्यानें त्यास कर्तेपणाचा विकार स्पर्श करीत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: And even if it is said that, the sagun has created the sagun (ie. sagun is doer) still it means that, that Reality has appeared. But doer-ship can never be put upon that nirgun.

owis.original: येथें कर्ताचि दिसेना । प्रत्यये आणावा अनुमाना । दृश्य सत्यत्वें असेना । म्हणोनियां ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें विचार केला तर सृष्टिचा कोणी कर्ता आढळत नाहीं. या प्रत्ययावरुन असें अनुमान काढावें लागतें कीं, हें दृश्य विश्र्व खरें नाहीं. म्हणून अशी अडचण उत्पन्न होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: And if a doer cannot be seen in maya then, why should such conjecture be placed upon that nirgun? Therefore, understand there is no truth to this visible and that nirgun is the only Truth.

owis.original: केलें तें अवघेंच लटिकें । तरी कर्ता हें बोलणेंचि फिकें । वक्ता म्हणे रे विवेकें । बरें पाहा ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कर्त्यानें जें केलें असें आपण म्हणतो तेंच जर मुळांत लटकें आहे, तर कर्ता कोण याची चौकशी व्यर्थ ठरते. वक्ता सांगतो कीं, याचा नीट विचार करुन तें समजून घ्या.
owis.englishMeaning: When that Reality is made false by the `many' opinions then, there is the mea- ningless talk of thoughtlessness, a doer and this `speech'. The speaker says, by vivek understand the best.

owis.original: बरें पाहातां प्रत्यये आला । तरी कां करावा गल्बला । प्रचित आलियां आपणाला । अंतर्यामी ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नीट विचार करुन ही गोष्ट मनाला एकदां पटली कीं घोटाळा उरणार नाहीं. आपल्या अंतर्यामी याची प्रचीति मात्र आली पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: When one understands the best, then that nirgun understanding has come. Then how will there be any confusion? Understand this sagun `experience' that has appeared within you (and as long as a `you' remains, there will be the thought of a doer. When no one remains then, doer, enjoyer, thoughtlessness etc, will not remain).

owis.original: आतां असो हें बोलणें । विवेकी तोचि हें जाणे । पूर्वपक्ष लागे उडवणें । येरवीं अनुर्वाच ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां हें बोलणें पुरें. जो विवेकीं असतो तोच हें जाणतो. पूर्वपक्षानें काढलेलें आक्षेप कसें सदोष आहेत हें दाखवावें लागतें. एरवी हा सिद्धांत शब्दानें वर्णन करतां येण्यासारखा नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Now, let this `speech' become thoughtless. Only the viveki can know thoughtlessness. The original hypothesis (ie. `God does all') needs to be discarded and then there can be that inexpressible brahman.

owis.original: तंव श्रोता करी प्रस्न । देहीं सुखदुःखभोक्ता कोण । पुढें हेंचि निरुपण । बोलिलें असे ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यावर श्रोत्यानें असा प्रश्र्ण केला कीं, " देहामध्यें सुख-दुःखाचा भोक्ता कोण? " पुढील समासांत या विषयाचे विवेचन आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But then the listener asked another question (ie. he stopped listening and a doubt arises in that doubtless), "In the body, who is the enjoyer of pleasures and pains?" Therefore ahead, this `speech' is to be always discoursed (and this question will not arise). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Atma Vivaran (The Examination of the Atma)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: आत्मयास शेरीरयोगें । उद्वेग चिंता करणे लागे । शरीरयोगें आत्मा जगे । हें तो प्रगटचि आहे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीराशी संबंध आल्यानें जीवात्म्याला दुःख व चिंता करावी लागते. शरीराच्या साहायानें जीवात्मा जगतो. हें तर अगदी प्रत्यक्षच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: It is due to the atma's association with this `all' body (ie. prakruti/purush) that there arises anxiety and worries (on account of prakruti/purush there comes body con- sciousness and then anxiety and doubts appear and questions get asked). And it is due to this association with this `all' body, that the atma is said to *exist/have beingness and that thoughtless unmanifest Self is said to become manifest. *(prakruti has the qualities of knowledge and existence. They are inseparable, like the light and heat of the sun. The `all', `thing' and `object' are the knowledge aspect. The `speech', `name' and `I am' are the existence aspect. Then that atma is said to exist, but in truth, that atma is beyond existence/knowledge)

owis.original: देह अन्नचि खायेना । तरी आत्मा कदापि जगेना । आत्म्याविण चेतना । देहास कैंची ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहानें अन्न खाल्लें नाहीं तर जीवात्मा कधींच जगूं शकत नाहीं. तसेंच जीवात्मा नसेल तर देहाला जिवंतपणा असत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If the gross body did not have this `food', the bliss of `I am' (existence) then, it could not exist for even a moment and then, that atma would not be able to live in this world. Therefore without that atma how could that gross body have any vitality? (Due to its association with the atma and this `I am'/life, the gross inert body appears to have life/vitality; but in truth, it appears within this `I am' and this is on account of that atma)

owis.original: हें येकावेगळें येक । करुं जातां निरार्थक । उभयेयोगें कोणीयेक । कार्य चाले ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह व जीवात्मा एकमेकांपासून वेगळें करायला जाणें व्यर्थ आहे. कारण दोघांच्या संयोगानेंच माणसाच्या जीवनांत सारी कार्ये घडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: It is not possible for that thoughtless One to do anything without this moving `all'. By the union of both, that One who is within everyone performs this `all action'. (That Reality cannot do anything and therefore the `two'/prakruti and purush were created; then by means of the `all' action of prakruti, that atma is said to function in this world and there is a doer. However this `all' or life has been neglected and there has appeared the `many' actions of a small jiva and it says "I do" and "I am alive")

owis.original: देहाला नाहीं चेतना । आत्म्यास पदार्थ उचलेना । स्वप्नभोजनें भरेना । पोट कांहीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नुसत्या देहाला जीवंतपण नसतें तर नुसत्या जीवात्म्याला पदार्थ उचलता येत नाहीं. एखादा माणूस स्वप्नामधें जेवला तर त्याचे पोट कांहीं भरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This gross body has no vitality, for it is inert. This vitality comes from the `I am'. And that atma on Its own cannot lift up any object (ie. every action is in truth, taking place within this `I am', for this `I am' is vitality/life. But due to ignorance, this `I am' has been superimposed upon the gross and inert body and an ego says, "I lift, I do" etc.). There may be the `experience' and enjoyment of this original dream but, this `thing' cannot fill your belly (in the original dream there is this enjoyment of the `all thing' and the food is the bliss of being; this dream is the pure sattwa guna and then there is only knowing. But this `thing' or knowledge cannot give satisfaction when you take yourself to be a body ie. when there is the dream within this dream. For gross body consciousness requires gross objective objects to sustain it; or such is its delusion).

owis.original: आत्मा स्वप्नअवस्थेंत जातो । परन्तु देहामध्यें हि असतो । निदसुरेपणें खाजवितो । चमत्कार पाहा ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवात्मा जेव्हा स्वप्नामधें जातो, तेव्हां तो देहामध्येंही असतो. झोपेंत तो शरीर खाजवतो. हें याचें प्रमाण होय. हा एक चमत्कार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The atma goes in this dream state/pure sattwa guna, but at the same time that atma is present in the gross body (ie. the mix of the three gunas. That atma is the Knower in the original dream of knowledge and by further objectification, there is the dream within that dream. Then there is a gross body and gross world of the jiva and the waking, dream and deep sleep states. Therefore simultaneously that atma plays in many states). Then being half-asleep this gross body gets scratched (this mix of the three gunas, of knowledge and ignorance, is body consciousness and it is like being half-asleep or half-wake. Then this one moving action of `I am' gets reduced to the insignificant actions of one small jiva in the prana). Therefore one should understand this miracle of `I am' (we say, "We do", but even in this `half-sleep' of rajo guna everything is happening automatically; the body breaths, eats and digests food, walks and scratches; who is doing? We say, "We do" but in truth, it is this association with the atma and knowledge that does)

owis.original: अन्नरसें वाढें शरीर । शरीरप्रमाणें विचार । वृद्धपणीं तदनंतर । दोनी लाहानाळती ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अन्नरसानें शरीर वाढतें. जसें जसें शरीर वाढतें तसा तसा विचारही वाढतो. त्यानंतर म्हातारपणीं शरीर व विचार दोन्हींचा संकोच होतो. दोन्ही लहान होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this *`food', the `all' body grows and on account of this `all' body, that thoughtless understanding comes (do not remain in body consciousness; understand this `all', stay in this `all' and expand yourself until this `all' or `I am' finally goes off and then, I do not exist). But due to old age (ie. "I am a body") this `all' body and thoughtlessness become less and less. *(siddharameshwar maharaj- we eat in many ways. By mouth, ears, eyes, mind etc....but without the food of `I am', we could not live for a moment even)

owis.original: उत्तम द्रव्य देह खातो । देहयोगें आत्मा भुलतो । विस्मरणें शुद्धि सांडितो । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह मादक पदार्थ सेवन करतो, त्याचा अम्मल जीवात्म्यावर होऊन तो भ्रमतो. त्याचे भान नाहींसें होते. आणि त्याची सगळी शुद्धि लोपते.
owis.englishMeaning: For when that best atma *eats through the gross body it gets intoxicated with sensual experiences and forgets Its own true nature. Due to this forgetting, that pure atma gives up this `all thing' and assumes gross body consciousness (that atma though completely detached accepted this `all' body as its own. But then due to desires etc. this `all' was neglected and there came the sensual experiences of body consciousness). *(By mouth, ears, eyes, mind, hands etc.)

owis.original: देहानें घेतलें वीष । आत्मा जाये सावकास । वाढणें मोडणें आत्मयास । नेमस्तआहे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहानें विष घेतलें तर त्याचा परीणाम होऊन जीवात्मा देह सोडतो. वाढणें, मोडणें या गोष्टी जीवात्म्यास निश्र्चिपणें भोगाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then due to this gross body, the poison of the world is accepted and that atma gets slowly destroyed. For then that atma has become a limited jiva and it grows and then it gets broken. (maharaj- the objects of this world are a slow poison)

owis.original: वाढणें मोडणें जाणें येणें । सुख दुःख देहाचेनि गुणें । नाना प्रकारें भोगणें । आत्मयास घडे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाढणें, मोडणें, जाणें, येणें, सुख आणि दुःख या गोष्टी देहाशी संयोग झाल्यानें जीवात्म्याला अनेक रीतीनें भोगाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: To grow, to break, to go, to come, pleasure and pain are all due to the gunas of the gross body. Then that atma meets `many' kinds of experiences/enjoyments.

owis.original: वारुळ म्हणिजे पोकळ । मुंग्यांचे मार्गचि सकळ । तैसेंचि हें केवळ । शरीर जाणावें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुंग्यांचें वारुळ आंतमधून पोकळ असतें. त्यांत मुंग्यांना जाण्यायेण्याचे मार्गच असतात. आपला देहसुद्धा वारुळासारखाच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' is like an empty ant-hill in which there are the pathways for many *ants. But know that it is that pure atma that has appeared as `all' body (and in that there are the `many' small *jivas running here and there).

owis.original: शरीरीं नाडीचा खेटा । नाडीमध्यें पोकळ वाटा । लाहान थोर सगटा । दाटल्या नाडी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या शरीरांत नाड्यांचा गुंतडा आहे. नाड्या आंतून पोकळ असतात. अशा लहान व मोठ्या पुष्कळ नाड्या शरीरांत आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `all' body there is a crowding of hollow vessels (ie. many bodies, just like the many ants) and within each hollow vessel there are empty pathways. But each small hollow vessels/jiva is completely filled by that great atma.

owis.original: प्राणी अन्नोदक घेतो । त्याचा अन्नरस होतो । त्यास वायो प्रवर्ततो । स्वासोस्वासें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्राणी अन्न खातो व पाणी पितो. त्याचा अन्नरस तयार होतो. त्या अन्नरसाला वायु श्वासोच्छ्वासानें प्रवाहित करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In the *prana, it is that atma who accepts the bread and water and it is that atma who appears as this `food' of `I am'. And it is that atma who moves this wind (of existence/knowledge) by means of the breath/prana (and then you feel, "I am existing and knowing"). *(When that atma takes itself to be the prana/breath then, there is gross body consciousness. This is the dream within the dream. Still, that atma remains within the original dream also. He is the one who knows the eating of bread and the drinking of water. He takes Himself to be this wind of existence/knowledge and feels `I am' and He moves this through the body by means of the prana. Still He remains separate from all this as the Witness and the mover and pervader of this wind also)

owis.original: नाडीद्वारां धांवे जीवन । जीवनामधें खेळें पवन । त्या पवनासरिसा जाण । आत्मा हि विवरे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीरांतील नाड्यांतून पाणी वाहते. त्या पाण्यामध्यें वायुदेखील वाहतो. त्या वायुबरोबर जीवात्मासुद्धां नाड्यांमधून संचार करतो. नाड्यांमधून जाणीवेचा प्रवाह पण असतो, हें सांगण्याचा हेतु आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Through each hollow vessel/jiva these waters of objectification run and in these waters this wind is playing. Know that when that atma is in association with this moving wind of `I am' then, that atma also appears to move. (There is nothing but that atma; wherever It is placed, It becomes like that only; It is the thoughtless still nirgun that is aloft from all this; It is the Knower/antar-atma when It meets with the wind and It is this moving wind; It is the prana, the gross objective body: It is everything experienced) (maharaj- `when you awake, space comes; where space is there, knowledge must be there; then the breath comes': Therefore first there is this `all' pervading experience `I am', in this everything is truly taking place and that atma is the Knower. Then the breath comes and that atma feels "I am a body" and `many' desires and `many' thoughts arise. This happens every morning when you awake, when knowledge awakes)

owis.original: तृषेनें शोकले शरीर । आत्म्यास कळे हा विचार । मग उठवून शरीर । चालवी उदकाकडे ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तहान लागून शरीराला शोष पडला कीं, तें जीवात्म्याला समजतें मग तो शरीराला उठवून पाण्याकडे नेतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And even when a strong desire troubles this body of the `all', still there is that atma understanding thoughtlessness (ie. desires may come and body consciousness may arise or not but in truth, that thoughtless Self always remains untouched and aloft). But when due to desires, this `all' body gets aroused then, it is made to move towards the water (ie. towards objectification). (Previously you were in yourself ie. this space between two thoughts. And then a desire arises; then this `all' starts to objectify and there is the soft creation of names and forms; just as from out of the ocean an individual wave arises; in this way, from out of the oneness of this `all' where everything is seen with equal vision, specific objects begin to appear according to the desires that arise and that ever free atma says, "I want this")

owis.original: उदक मागे शब्द बोलवी । मार्ग पाहोन शरीर चालवी । शरीर अवघें च हालवी । प्रसंगानुसार ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मला पाणी पाहिजे " असें शब्द जीवात्मा शरीराकडून बोलवतो. रस्ता नीट बघून तो शरीरास चालवतो. जसाजसा  प्रसंग येईल तशी तशी शरीराकडून हालचाल करवितो.
owis.englishMeaning: But before such objectification begun, that atma was `speaking' this `word' and at that time, this `all' was moving on the path of understanding (ie. `I am'). And even when body consciousness arises upon this `all' body still, that One has not lost this `all' connection (even when there is the dream within the dream due to desires still, that original dream of `I am' cannot be invalidated, for in truth, everything is taking place there only. Therefore forget this dream full of desires and imagination, and He is there ie. knowledge is there).

owis.original: क्षुधा लागते ऐसें जाणतो । मग देहास उठवितो । आच्यावाच्या बोलवितो । ज्यासी त्यासी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भूक लागली असें जीवात्मा जाणतो. मग तो देहाला उटवतो. आणि जेवायला उशीर झाला म्हणून तो ज्याला त्याला अद्वातद्वा बोलायला लावतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is hunger, it is that atma that knows. It is that atma that makes the gross body get up and it is that atma that is made to `speak' thoughtlessly to that atma (who is his wife). (There is nothing but yourself in the world but due to `many' desires, body consciousness arises and one sees another and speaks roughly to another)

owis.original: बायेकांत म्हणे जालें जालें । देह सोवळें करुन आणिलें । पायांत भरुन चालविलें । तांतडीं तांतडीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायकोच्या शरीरांतील जीवात्म्याला म्हणतो, " झालें जेवण तयार झालें चला " मग हा देहाला सोवळे नेसवतो. आणि पायांकडून चालवून तातडीनें जेवायला नेतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then within the wife, it is the atma that says, "It is ready, it is ready" and the gross body gets washed and brought to the table. It is the atma that pervades throughout the legs and makes them to move quickly.

owis.original: त्यासी पात्रावरी बैसविलें । नेत्रीं भरोन पात्र पाहिलें । हाताकरवीं आरंभिलें । आपोशन ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाला तो पानावर बसवतो. मग डोळ्यांत भरुन वाढलेले पान बघतो. आणि हाताला आपोशन करायला लावतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is made to sit down before a plate and It pervades the eyes and looks at the food. Moving the hands, It begins the customary prayer.

owis.original: हाताकरवीं ग्रास उचलवी । मुखीं जाऊन मुख पसरवी । दातांकरवीं चाववी । नेटें नेटें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नंतर जीवात्मा हाताला घास उचलावयाला लावतो. तोंडापाशीं नेल्यावर तोंड उघडावयास लावतो. आणि दांतांकडून नीटपणें चाववून घेतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The hand is made to raise a mouthful of food. The mouth is made to open and food is placed in the mouth, the teeth are made to chew carefully.

owis.original: आपण जिव्हेमधें खेळे । पाहतो परिमळसोहळे । केंस काडी खडा कळे । तत्काळ थुंकी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हाच जीवात्मा जीभेमध्यें संचार करुन स्वाद आणि सुवास यांचा आनंद भोगतो. अन्नांत केस, काडी किंवा खडा लागला तर जाणतो व लगेच थुंकुन टाकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: It is our own Self that plays in the tongue. It is that atma that understands the good smell of the tasty food. It is the atma that knows there is a hair or a small piece of straw in the lentils. Or if it finds a small stone in the rice then, in this time of the `all', It spits it out (you say "I do" but it is that atma in association with the wind that is doing and knowing everything in this `time of the all').

owis.original: आळणी कळतां मीठ मागे । बायलेसि म्हणे आगे कांगे । डोळे ताऊन पाहों लागे । रागें रागें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पदार्थ आळणी झाला असेल तर जीवात्मा मीठ मागतो. " असे कां गें " असें ओरडून बायकोकडे डोळे वटारुन रागानें पाहातो.
owis.englishMeaning: The man feels there is not enough salt and demands some. He says to his wife, "Ah, what is this trash" and it is that atma that stares at her with rage.

owis.original: गोडी लागतांच आनंदे । गोड नस्तां परम खेदे । वांकडी गोष्टी अंतरीं भेदे । आत्मयासी ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गोड पदार्थ खातांना जीवात्म्याला आनंद होतो. पदार्थ गोड नसेल तर त्याला मोठें वाईट वाटते. वाईट गोष्टीनें जीवात्म्याच्या अंतर्यामी क्लेश होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is a liking for the food then there is bliss and if not, then that Supreme atma becomes unhappy. Then this `I am' feeling within the inner space has got distorted and is separated from that atma (you who are that atma has not remained aloft within this inner space and has accepted body consciousness. Then there are `many' likes and dislikes).

owis.original: नाना अन्नाची गोडी । नाना रसें स्वाद निवडी । तिखट लागतां मस्तक झाडी । आणी खोंकीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा जीवात्मा अनेक प्रकारच्या अन्नाची गोडी घेतो. अनेक रसांची चव निवडतो. पदार्थ तिखट लागला तर डोकें झाडतो. आणि त्याला ठसका लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are the `many' *tastes of that essential `food' (when that atma sees through the sense organs then, the `I am' feeling gets covered over with good and bad etc.). Then the `many' sweet flavours are chosen and tasted. If it is too spicy, he shakes his head and coughs. *(maharaj- you want a specific taste or a specific thing...do not be specific)

owis.original: मिरपुडी घातली फार । कायसें करितों खापर । जिव्हेकरवीं कठिणोत्तर । बोलवी रागें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग तो रागावून बोलायला लावतो कीं, " मिरपूड फार घातली, खापरासारखा हा काय पदार्थ केला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: "There's too much chilli. You are useless and can't do anything right!" And then out of anger, it is the atma that makes the tongue to `speak' a harsh reply to her husband.

owis.original: आज्य उदंड जेविला । सवेंच तांब्या उचलिला । घळघळां घेऊं लागला । सावकास ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तुपाचे पक्वान्न फार खाल्ल्याने तहान फार लागते. म्हणून तो लगेच तांब्या उचलायला लावतो आणि घटाघटा पाणी प्यायला लावतो.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that vast thoughtless paramatma that enjoys these fruits of past actions (let whatever has to come come; but you say, "I want this like this" etc.) Of Its own accord, that atma picks up this gross body and starts drinking copiously (ie. due to desires we forget our own effortless Self and agree to gross body consciousness).

owis.original: देहीं सुखदुःखभोक्ता । तो येक आत्माचि पाहातां । आत्म्याविण देह वृथा । मडें होये ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामध्यें राहणारा आणि सुखदुःखें भोगणारा एक जीवात्माच होय. जीवात्मा देहांत नसेल तर देह केवळ प्रेत बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this gross body there are the experiences of pains and pleasures but, when you understand then, there is only that One atma. And without that atma the body is a useless corpse.

owis.original: मनाच्या अनंत वृत्ति । जाणणें तेचि आत्मस्थिती । त्रैलोकीं जितुका वेक्ती । तदांतरीं आत्मा ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनामध्यें अनंत वृत्ति निर्माण होतात. जीवात्मा त्या सर्व जाणतो. सर्व वृत्ति जाणणें, हाच त्याचा खरा धर्म होय. त्रैलोक्यामध्यें जितक्या व्यक्ति आहेत तितक्या सर्वांच्या अंतर्यामी जीवात्मा वास करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that endless paramatma becomes this vritti of the mind then, to that thou- ghtless atma there comes knowingness. Understand that wherever there is a manifest shape in these three worlds (of waking, dream and sleep), there is also that atma within this `all' (ego sees the many shapes and says "I know" but still it is that atma within this `all' that is truly knowing).

owis.original: जगामध्यें जगदात्मा । विश्र्वामधें विश्र्वात्मा । सर्व चालवी सर्वात्मा । नाना रुपें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगाच्या अंतर्यामी असणारा तो जगदात्मा, विश्र्वाच्या अंतर्यामीं असणारा तो विश्र्वात्मा होय. अंतरात्मा अथवा सर्वात्मा अशारीतीनें अनेक रुपें घेऊन सर्वांना चालवितो.
owis.englishMeaning: In this world, He is the atma of the world; in this universe, He is the *universal atma. It is that atma of the `all' that makes the `all' and the `many' forms move. *(paramatma)

owis.original: हुंगे चाखे ऐके देखे । मृद कठिण वोळखे । शीत उष्ण ठाउकें । तत्काळ होये ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या अंतरात्म्याला सर्व कांहीं ओळखता येतें. तो वास घेतो, स्वाद घेतो, ऐकतो, पाहतो, मऊ आणि कठीण ओळखतो. गरम आणि थंड त्याला तत्काळ समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: He smells, tastes, listens and looks. He recognizes soft and hard. At that time, it is He who knows cold and hot (there is smelling, tasting etc. and the jiva says, "I taste this", but this is all taking place within this `time' of the sagun understanding. It is truly He who knows sweet and spicy and what needs more salt etc. But He knows these things are all happening in zero/nothing and so `many' thoughts do not arise) (maharaj- the Saint is not a fool. I know if this is sweet or not).

owis.original: सावधपणें लाघवी । बहुत करी उठाठेवी । या धूर्ताच्या उगवी । धूर्तचि करी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अत्यंत चतुर असणारा असा हा जीवात्मा लक्ष देऊन कितीतरी प्रकारच्या खटपटी करतो. त्या चतुर जीवात्म्याचा उलगडा, खरा चतुर पुरुषच करुं शकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to His alertness and skill, this `all' gets created within the toils and troubles of this world. He is the sharpest of the sharp and the doer within this original `speech'.

owis.original: वायोसरिसा परिमळ येतो । परि तो परिमळ वितळोन जातो । वायो धुळी घेउनी येतो । परी ते हि जाये ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वारा जेव्हां वाहतो तेव्हां त्याच्याबरोबर सुगंध येतो. पण तो सुगंध कांहीं काळानेम विरुन जातो. वाराजेव्हां वाहतो तेव्हां त्याच्याबरोबर धूळ येते. पण ती देखील नाहींशी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is that atma (ie. mula purush) together with this wind (mula maya) then, any fragrance may be brought but, if that atma becomes like this fragrance then, It dissipates along with the fragrance (maharaj- you want to touch everything...don't take the touch). And when this wind picks up this dust (ie. a gross body) and that atma accepts it then, that Reality gets completely spoiled (if you, that atma, forget Yourself then, body consciousness arises. Then the objects of the world, like good and bad smells are perceived. When this wind of `I am everywhere' becomes objective then, a gross body and gross creation made up of nothing but dust only, is taken to be true).

owis.original: शीत उष्ण वायोसरिसें । सुवासें अथवा कुवासें । असिजे परी सावकासें । तगणे न घडे ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गरम आणी थंड, सुगंध आणी दुर्गंध वगैरे गोष्टी वायुबरोबर वाहात येतात. परंतु त्या हार वेळ टिकत नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: Cold and hot comes along with this wind and there are `many' good and bad smells. They appear but still they do not remain with this wind (this knowing brings all these experiences but this knowing should just let them flow by like the waters of a river and not attach itself to them; otherwise thoughts and body consciousness will arise and one will say, "It is good, bad" etc.). (maharaj- say everything is so, so)

owis.original: वायोसरिसे रोग येती । वायोसरिसी भूतें धांवती । धूर आणी धुकटें येती । वायोसवें ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायुबरोबर रोग येतात. भुतें धांवतात, त्याचप्रमाणें धूर व धूकेंसुद्धां येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma along with this wind, brings this disease, "I am a body". That atma along with this wind, brings these great elements and runs around fruitlessly due to objectification. That atma brings blinding pride and dim appearances (ie. shapes and forms seen through body consciousness) when it is in association with this wind.

owis.original: वायोसवें कांहींच जगेना । आत्म्यासवें वायो तगेना । आत्म्याची चपळता जाणा । अधिक आहे ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण यापैकी कोणतीही गोष्ट वायुबरोबर कायम टिकत नाहीं. जीवात्म्या बरोबर तुलना केली तर वायु त्याच्यासमोर टिकत नाही. वायूपेक्षां जीवात्मा अधिक सूक्ष्म व चपळ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as nothing can exist along with the wind (ie. smells and tastes come and go away), so too, this wind cannot remain along with that atma. Know that the swiftness of the atma is greater than that of the wind (in Him there is no space or time. And when He pervades this wind of the `all' then, He is everywhere and always previous to everything. In this way, there can be none swifter than Him. Whatever you perceive, you perceive within Him).

owis.original: वायो कठिणास आडतो । आत्मा कठिण भेदून जातो । कठिण पाहों तरी तो । छेदेहिना ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कठिण पदार्थांमध्यें वायु अडतो. पण आपल्या आड येणारा कठिण पदार्थ भेदून जीवात्मा पलीकडे जातो. जीवात्म्याचा कठिणपणा इतका आहे कीं, त्याचा छेद करतां येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma resists the hardness/grossness of the wind and does not allow this wind to enter within it. Yet that atma penetrates this wind of maya. That sees maya, but that atma is not divided by her (He pervades everything and therefore knows everything within Himself).

owis.original: वायो झडझडां वाजे । आत्मा कांहींच न वाजे । मोनेंचि अंतरीं समजे । विवरोन पाहातां ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वार्याचा झडझड असा आवाज येतो, जीवात्म्याचा मुळींच आवाज येत नाहीं. जो कोणीं मौन धरुन त्याचे चिंतन व मनन करील त्याला स्वतःच्या अंतर्यामीच तो कळून येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: This wind makes a lot of noise but that atma does not touch this noisy `thing' (that says `I am'). One can understand that nirgun atma if this inner space is searched in silence/mouna.12

owis.original: शरीरास बरें केलें । तें आत्मयास पावलें । शरीरयोगें जालें । समाधान ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीराला कांहीं चांगलें उपचार केलें तर ते जीवात्म्याला पावतात. शरीराच्याद्वारे जीवात्म्याला समाधान मिळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `all' body becomes the best and that thoughtless atma attains Its own Self. In this way, due to Its association with the `all' body, that atma gains complete contentment.

owis.original: देहावेगळे उपाये नाना । करितां आत्मयास पावेना । समाधान पावे वासना । देहाचेनि ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहा व्यतिरिक्त अनेक उपचार केले तर ते जीवात्म्याला पोचत नाहींत. फक्त देहाच्याद्वारेच जीवात्म्याला वासनेचे समाधान मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: When this remedy of the `all' body is the `many' different bodies then, that atma cannot be attained. Still understand, this vasana (ie. the `all' body that just wants to exist) can only attain that complete contentment (of not existing) with the help of a gross body (this is the importance of the gross body and this should be understood).

owis.original: देहआत्मयाचें कौतुक । पाहों जातां हें अनेक । देहावेगळी आडणुक । आत्मयास होये ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह व जीवात्मा यांच्या संयोगाचें कौतुक असें अनेक प्रकारचे आहे. देह नसेल तर जीवात्म्याची अनेक प्रकारे अडचण होतें. त्याला अडल्यासारखें होते.
owis.englishMeaning: This wonder of knowledge is a result of the gross body and that atma together. But when you try to see that thoughtless atma with the gross body then, that atma becomes these numerous different forms (objectification arises). Still, without a gross 12sadachar V. 621-22. When the *upanishads have been fully imbibed then, one is making shravan and this is called listening to the guru's teachings. When everything different to this `all' has been left aside and ones fondness is for this `all' only, then... *(Finally they say, "neti, neti"/ "Not this, not that"; total negation of everything) This is the study of the veda. And this attention is the mouna of the sadhak. body, that atma cannot be gained (only while living can this understanding be gained. Other promises are only rumours).

owis.original: येक असतां उदंड घडे । वेगळें पाहातां कांहींच न घडे । विवेकें त्रैलोकीं पवाडे । देहात्मयोगें ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह व जीवात्मा एकत्र असतां असंख्य गोष्टी होऊं शकतात. दोघांना वेगळें केल्यास एकेकट्याच्या हातून कांहींच होऊं शकत नाहीं. दोघांचा संयोग असेल तर विवेकाच्या बळावर त्रैलोक्यााचा ठाव घेतां येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One exists then, that vast paramatma has appeared and is seeing Its own reflection (ie. existence). But when you truly understand this separateness then, this `thing' no longer appears (in Oneness this separateness has been imagined). But first with vivek and with the union of that atma and this gross body, one should enter within these three worlds (ie. one should be beyond the waking, dream and sleep states of this body. Taking ourselves to be a body, our thoughts are of that only. We confine ourselves to this waking world. In our dreams we are not so confined. maharaj- `your power is so free when you dream. Here it takes nine months to have a baby, there it can happen immediately': But when we meet the Master, He frees our power by showing us we are not the body; we are that power of knowing and being). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Sikvan Nirupan (A Discourse on the Teaching)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पालेमाळा सुमनमाळा । फळमाळा बीजमाळा । पाषाणमाळा कवडेमाळा । सूत्रें चालती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झाडाचा पाला, फुलें, फळें, बीजें, पाषाण, आणि कवड्या यांच्या माळा करतात. पण त्या सगळ्या दोर्‍यामुळें - दोरा ओवल्यामुळें - होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the garlands of leaves,13 garlands of flowers, garlands of fruits and garlands of seeds; there are garlands of stones and garlands of shells and that One atma is present, due to this thread that runs through them all (ie. still there is that atma within this knowledge upon which these `many' forms have appeared).

owis.original: स्फटिकमाळा मोहरेमाळा । काष्टमाळा गंधमाळा । धातुमाळा रत्नमाळा । जाळ्या वोलि चांदोवे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें स्फटिकमणी, मोहोरमणी, काष्ट, गंध, धातु, रत्नें यांच्यादेखील माळा करतात. शिवाय जाळ्या, ओळी आणि चांदवे, या वस्तुदेखील सुतापासून तयार करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the garlands of crystals,14 garlands of gems, garlands of wood and garlands of sandalwood; there are the garlands of dhatu and the garlands of jewels; and these are all woven together into this covering called existence. (maharaj- in this world the beggar and the Saint are needed).

owis.original: परी हे तंतूनें चालतें । तंतू नस्तां विष्कळित होतें । तैसें म्हणों आत्मयाते । तरी साहित्य न पडे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या माळांमध्यें दोरा ओवलेला असतो. दोरा नसेल तर मणी विस्कळीत होतात. त्याचप्रमाणें आत्मा सर्व वस्तुंमध्यें ओवलेला असतोअसें म्हणतात. पण दोर्‍याचा दृष्टांत आत्म्याला संपूर्णपणें लागूं पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But then, on account of this thread of knowledge within these garlands, that thou- ghtless Self is moving. Yet if there was no thread then, the garlands could not be held together. Still if you call this thread the atma then still, your companionship of prakruti/purush has not ceased (do not think that this connection/thread ie. `I am'/pra- kruti is the true God; that atma is quite different).

owis.original: तंतूस मणी वोविला । तंतूमध्येंचि राहिला । आत्मा सर्वांगी व्यापला । पाहाना कां ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दोरा मण्यांतून जातो. मणी दोर्‍याच्या आधारानें राहतो. परंतु दोरा मण्याला व्यापून असत नाहीं. देहांत आत्मा राहातो. तो देहाचे सर्वांग व्यापून असतो. हें लक्षांत घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Every object is held together by this `I am' connection and within this connection they always remain. But when there is this `I am' connection then, that atma that pervades 13Leaves and flowers moving and non-moving bodies, and the flowers of experiences; the fruits and seeds pains and pleasure and seeds of karma; stones and shells the hard bodies they occupy. 14Or, crystals grandeur and honour; gems- valiant and accomplished; wood- lank and lean dry bodies; sandalwood-bodies used and worn away to know the Self; dhatu- the seven essential components of the body; jewels thoughtlessness and this `word' and the nine devotions. this `all' body has not been understood (the relationship of pervader and pervaded, prakruti/purush still remains and that witness purush appears like the witnessed. Still understand, every object is appearing within this knowledge).

owis.original: आत्मा चपळ सहजगुणें । दोरी काये चळों जाणे । म्हणोन दृष्टांत देणें । साहित्य न घडे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्म्याच्या ठिकाणी चेतना सहजपणें आहे. ती दोर्‍याच्या ठिकाणी नाहीं. म्हणून दोर्‍याचा दृष्टांत आत्म्याला लागू पडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that atma, on account of this natural pure sattwa guna, is most active (ie. then that atma purush becomes this pure sattwa guna of prakruti and there is knowing and moving).
